This doesn't prevent ordinary Death Saving Throws, regeneration, resurrection, or features that genuinely prevent death.

entries.name: Epicenter
entries: If the Direct Hit target is Huge or larger, the strike tears through its entire body rather than merely striking one point. Against such a creature, the additional {@damage 20d12} Force damage from Direct Hit is treated as damage from the creature's entire body being struck and can't be avoided merely because part of the creature lies outside the spell's area.

spell.name: Final Extinction
entries: You designate one creature you can see within range and force its entire existence toward a single terminal moment. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.

entries.name: Extinction Strike
entries: On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 40d12} Necrotic damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. This damage ignores Resistance to Necrotic damage. Necrotic Immunity instead functions as Resistance against this spell.

entries.name: Mortal Collapse
entries: After taking the damage, if the target has 150 Hit Points or fewer, it must make a second Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies. On a successful save, it survives normally. A creature with Legendary Resistance can expend one use to succeed on this saving throw.

entries.name: Beyond Death
entries: If the target dies from this spell, choose one of the following forms of extinction:

entries.name: Body Extinction
entries: The target's body is completely destroyed. No corpse or physical remains are left behind.

entries.name: Soul Extinction
entries: The target's soul is violently severed from its body. Until restored by a 9th-level spell, Artifact, deity, or effect of comparable power, the creature can't be returned to life.

entries.name: Total Extinction
entries: If the creature failed both saving throws from this spell, you can choose this option instead. Its body is destroyed and its soul becomes unreachable by effects of 8th level or lower. This doesn't erase the creature from history, memory, or reality.

entries.name: Deathless Prey
entries: Creatures that normally don't need a soul, can't die of old age, reform after death, regenerate from destruction, possess multiple bodies, possess phylacteries, possess external anchors, or return through a similar feature aren't automatically immune to this spell. If such a creature dies from Final Extinction, its normal return feature is suppressed for 7 days. An Artifact, 9th-level effect, deity, or feature of comparable power can bypass this suppression.

entries.name: Break the Immortal
entries: If the target has a feature that would automatically prevent its death, return it to life immediately, or cause it to remain at 1 Hit Point, that feature can function only once against this spell. After it functions, the target must immediately make another Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies despite that feature.

entries.name: Extinction Pressure
entries: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this spell can't take Reactions, teleport, transform, transfer its soul, enter another body, or voluntarily move its consciousness elsewhere until the end of the current turn.

entries.name: Legendary Prey
entries: If the target has Legendary Actions, Legendary Resistance, Mythic traits, or a CR of 20 or higher, it takes an additional {@damage 10d12} Necrotic damage after resolving the initial damage. This additional damage is subject to the same Resistance and Immunity rules as the rest of the spell.

entries.name: No Lesser Protection
entries: An effect of 8th level or lower can't make the target immune to this spell, redirect the spell to another creature, replace the target with another creature, or negate the death caused by Mortal Collapse. Such an effect can still grant bonuses, Advantage, Temporary Hit Points, or other protections that don't completely negate the spell.

spell.name: Heaven-Piercer
entries: You compress overwhelming magical force into a single incandescent spear and release it in a perfectly straight path. Choose a point you can see within range. A beam 20 feet wide erupts from you and extends in a straight line to that point, continuing another 1,000 feet beyond it.

entries.name: Piercing Ray
entries: Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 32d12} Radiant or Force damage (your choice when you cast the spell). On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. The spell's damage ignores Resistance. A creature immune to the chosen damage type instead has Resistance against this spell.

entries.name: First in the Path
entries: Choose one creature in the line as the Primary Target. The Primary Target makes its saving throw with Disadvantage. If it fails, it takes an additional {@damage 12d12} damage of the spell's chosen damage type.

entries.name: Unbroken Trajectory
entries: The beam doesn't stop when it strikes a creature or object. It continues through creatures, objects, walls, buildings, magical barriers, terrain, and similar obstructions until it reaches the end of its path.

entries.name: Pierce the Impossible
entries: An effect of 8th level or lower can't cause the beam to stop prematurely, reflect, redirect, split, be absorbed, or vanish. A barrier created by an effect of 8th level or lower can still reduce damage if it normally does so, but it can't prevent the beam from continuing beyond it.

entries.name: Fortress Borer
entries: Objects and structures in the line automatically fail their saving throws. They take maximum damage from this spell. The spell deals double damage to walls, fortifications, vehicles, Constructs, magical barriers, and other artificial structures. If the beam destroys enough material to pass through an obstacle, it creates a tunnel at least 20 feet wide through that obstacle.

entries.name: Sundering Defenses
entries: Before resolving damage against each creature, choose one magical defensive effect currently affecting it that was created by a spell of 8th level or lower. That effect is suppressed against Heaven-Piercer until the spell finishes resolving against that creature. Examples include magical damage Resistance, magical shielding, damage reduction, magical cover, effects that cause attacks to automatically miss, or similar defenses. The defensive effect resumes afterward if its duration hasn't ended.

entries.name: Titanic Penetration
entries: Against a Huge or larger creature, the beam can pass through its entire body. Such a creature can't avoid the spell merely because only part of its space intersects the line. If at least half of its space intersects the beam, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw.

entries.name: Celestial Wound
entries: A creature that fails its saving throw also suffers a Celestial Wound until the end of your next turn. While wounded, it can't regain Hit Points, its regeneration doesn't function, and Temporary Hit Points can't be granted to it. An Artifact, 9th-level effect, deity, or feature of comparable power can ignore this restriction.

entries.name: Afterimage of Ruin
entries: The path of the beam remains visibly scorched, vitrified, split, or otherwise marked according to the damage type used. Ordinary terrain damage created by the spell is permanent until repaired naturally or magically.

spell.name: Starheart
entries: You ignite a fragment of stellar matter inside the body of one creature you can see, turning the target itself into the vessel of an unborn star. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it takes {@damage 15d12} Radiant damage plus {@damage 15d12} Fire damage, and the spell ends. On a failed save, it takes the same damage and gains a Starheart for the duration.

entries.name: Internal Star
entries: The Starheart exists inside the target rather than occupying a space on the battlefield. It moves with the target, can't be physically removed, requires no Concentration from you, remains active even if the target teleports or travels to another plane, and can't be targeted separately from the creature containing it. An effect of 8th level or lower can't dispel, suppress, extract, or transfer the Starheart.

entries.name: First Pulse
entries: At the end of the target's next turn, the Starheart erupts internally. The target takes {@damage 10d12} Radiant damage plus {@damage 10d12} Fire damage. The target must then make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Second Pulse
entries: At the end of the target's following turn, the Starheart grows violently unstable. The target takes {@damage 15d12} Radiant damage plus {@damage 15d12} Fire damage. Until the Starheart detonates, the target can't regain Hit Points, its regeneration doesn't function, and its Hit Point Maximum can't be increased.

entries.name: Supernova
entries: At the end of the target's third turn after the spell was cast, the Starheart collapses and detonates. The target takes {@damage 20d12} Radiant damage plus {@damage 20d12} Fire damage. It then makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes an additional {@damage 20d12} Force damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much Force damage. The Starheart then disappears.

entries.name: External Detonation
entries: When the Supernova occurs, every other creature of your choice within 120 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 12d12} Radiant damage plus {@damage 12d12} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. The creature carrying the Starheart doesn't take this external damage in addition to the Supernova damage.

entries.name: Stellar Penetration
entries: All damage dealt by Starheart ignores Resistance to Fire and Radiant damage. Fire or Radiant Immunity instead functions as Resistance against this spell. The Force damage from Supernova ignores Force Resistance; Force Immunity instead functions as Resistance.

entries.name: Unstable Vessel
entries: Whenever the target uses Teleportation, planar travel, Shapechanging, possession, or an effect that transfers its consciousness into another body, the Starheart follows the target's true consciousness. Changing bodies doesn't escape the spell. If the target genuinely divides into multiple independent creatures, the Starheart remains with the original consciousness.

entries.name: Premature Detonation
entries: If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points before the Supernova occurs, the Starheart immediately detonates. Resolve Supernova and External Detonation at once. The target still takes the Supernova damage even while at 0 Hit Points.

entries.name: Stellar Execution
entries: If the target dies from damage dealt by the Starheart, its body is reduced to incandescent ash. Its ordinary equipment survives unless the DM determines an object was especially vulnerable to the blast. The creature can still be restored to life normally, but an effect of 8th level or lower can't use an intact corpse as part of that resurrection because none remains.

entries.name: Greater Vessel
entries: If the target is Huge or larger, has Legendary Actions, Legendary Resistance, Mythic traits, or CR 20 or higher, the Starheart feeds upon its exceptional vitality. Each internal Pulse and the Supernova deals an additional {@damage 5d12} Radiant damage.

spell.name: Godslayer
entries: You manifest a colossal weapon of condensed magical power and bring it down upon a creature with enough force to wound beings that lesser magic can barely touch. Choose one creature you can see within range. The manifested weapon can appear as any weapon you choose, such as a sword, spear, axe, hammer, scythe, or another appropriate form. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

entries.name: Godslaying Blow
entries: On a hit, the target takes {@damage 30d12} Force damage plus {@damage 20d12} damage of one type you choose from Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Radiant, or Thunder. The attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

entries.name: Overwhelming Impact
entries: Damage from this spell ignores Resistance, treats Immunity as Resistance, ignores damage reduction created by effects of 8th level or lower, and can't be reduced to 0 by an effect of 8th level or lower.

entries.name: Colossal Target
entries: If the target is Huge or larger, it takes an additional {@damage 10d12} Force damage. If it is Gargantuan, it instead takes an additional {@damage 20d12} Force damage.

entries.name: Legendary Slayer
entries: If the target has Legendary Actions, Legendary Resistance, Mythic traits, or is CR 20 or higher, the attack gains a +5 bonus to the attack roll. On a hit against such a creature, it also takes an additional {@damage 10d12} Force damage.

entries.name: Shatter the Defense
entries: Before making the attack roll, choose one defensive magical effect of 8th level or lower affecting the target. That effect provides no benefit against this attack. This can suppress effects such as magical AC bonuses, automatic misses, magical damage reduction, magical immunity, or similar defensive protections for this attack only.

entries.name: Catastrophic Critical
entries: If the attack is a Critical Hit, don't roll the spell's damage dice twice. Instead, the attack deals maximum damage for all of its damage dice.

entries.name: World-Shaking Strike
entries: If the attack hits, the impact also devastates the area around the target. Each other creature within 30 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 10d12} Force damage and is knocked Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked Prone. You can choose any number of creatures to be unaffected.

entries.name: Unbroken Weapon
entries: The manifested weapon can strike incorporeal creatures, Ethereal creatures, creatures inside magical barriers, and creatures protected by effects that would normally prevent ordinary physical contact. An effect of 8th level or lower can't intercept, redirect, or substitute another creature for the chosen target. The weapon disappears immediately after the attack resolves.

spell.name: Worldshout
entries: You release a single utterance carrying enough supernatural force to shake the world before you. The sound erupts from you in a 1-mile cone. You can choose any number of creatures within the cone to be unaffected by the spell.

entries.name: Voice of Cataclysm
entries: Every affected creature in the cone must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 24d12} Thunder damage plus {@damage 12d12} Force damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. This damage ignores Resistance to Thunder damage. Thunder Immunity instead functions as Resistance against this spell.

entries.name: Point-Blank Devastation
entries: Creatures within 120 feet of you are struck by the full pressure of the shout. Such a creature makes its saving throw with Disadvantage and takes an additional {@damage 12d12} Thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much additional damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Crushing Wave
entries: A creature that fails its saving throw is hurled directly away from you.
The distance depends on its Size:

items: Tiny–Medium: 200 feet
Large: 150 feet
Huge: 100 feet
Gargantuan: 50 feet

entries: The creature is also knocked Prone. If it collides with a solid object before completing this movement, both the creature and the object take {@damage 1d12} Bludgeoning damage for every 20 feet of movement remaining, to a maximum of {@damage 10d12}.

entries.name: Ruptured Senses
entries: A creature that fails its saving throw is Deafened for 1 hour. If it fails the save by 5 or more, it is also Stunned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Break the Silence
entries: Worldshout functions even in an area of magical silence. An effect of 8th level or lower can't suppress the spell's verbal component, prevent the shout from propagating, absorb the sound completely, or render a creature immune to the spell merely by preventing ordinary sound from reaching it. The spell isn't dependent on air and functions underwater, in a vacuum, and in other environments where ordinary sound couldn't travel.

entries.name: Shatter the World
entries: Objects and structures in the cone automatically fail their saving throws and take maximum damage. The spell deals double damage to walls, buildings, fortifications, vehicles, siege engines, crystalline objects, and other rigid structures. Nonmagical objects that aren't being worn or carried and are reduced to 0 Hit Points are shattered into debris.

entries.name: Collapse
entries: A structure that loses at least half its Hit Points from this spell begins to collapse immediately if its physical construction would allow it. You decide whether structures belonging to creatures you excluded from the spell are affected.

entries.name: Dispel the Voice
entries: The shout tears through lesser magical barriers. When the wave reaches a magical wall, dome, barrier, or similar obstruction created by a spell of 8th level or lower, the barrier takes 100 Force damage before determining whether the spell continues through it. If the barrier is destroyed or normally allows effects to pass through it, Worldshout continues beyond it normally.

entries.name: Resonant Ruin
entries: Creatures made primarily from stone, crystal, glass, metal, or another rigid inorganic substance have Disadvantage on their saving throw. This includes appropriate Constructs and other creatures regardless of creature type.

entries.name: Aftershock
entries: Immediately after the initial wave passes, the ground and large structures throughout the cone violently tremble. Affected creatures standing on the ground must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall Prone. Creatures that already failed the initial saving throw automatically fail this save. The Aftershock doesn't deal additional damage.

spell.name: Heavenstorm
entries: You call down a primordial bolt of lightning and command it to hunt through your enemies faster than thought. Choose one creature you can see within range as the First Target. The First Target must make a Dexterity saving throw.

entries.name: First Thunder
entries: On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 30d12} Lightning damage plus {@damage 10d12} Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Lightning and Thunder Resistance don't apply to this spell. Immunity to either damage type instead functions as Resistance against that portion of the damage.

entries.name: Chain of Heaven
entries: After striking the First Target, the lightning leaps to another creature of your choice within 300 feet of the previous target. It can continue jumping in this way to as many as nine additional creatures. Each new target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 20d12} Lightning damage plus {@damage 10d12} Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature normally can't be selected more than once.

entries.name: Return Stroke
entries: After the final creature is struck, the bolt reverses course. Choose up to three creatures already struck by this spell. Each chosen creature is struck again and must make another Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 12d12} Lightning damage plus {@damage 8d12} Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

entries.name: Focused Tempest
entries: If fewer than ten creatures are available, you can redirect unused jumps into creatures already struck. A creature can receive no more than three total strikes from one casting of Heavenstorm. Each additional strike requires a new saving throw and deals the normal damage for that stage of the spell.

entries.name: Conductive Ruin
entries: Whenever a creature fails a saving throw against this spell, it becomes Conductive until the spell finishes resolving. Each time a Conductive creature is struck again by Heavenstorm, it takes an additional {@damage 5d12} Lightning damage. This bonus stacks for repeated strikes.

entries.name: Thunderbreak
entries: A creature that fails any saving throw against this spell is knocked Prone. If it fails by 5 or more, it is also Stunned until the end of its next turn. Huge and Gargantuan creatures aren't immune to these effects.

entries.name: Storm Through All Things
entries: The lightning can leap through walls, water, magical darkness, storms, solid terrain, and magical barriers. You don't need to see targets after the First Target, but you must know or perceive that they are present. An effect of 8th level or lower can't ground, absorb, redirect, or terminate the lightning.

entries.name: Living Conductor
entries: A creature wearing or primarily composed of substantial amounts of metal has Disadvantage on its saving throws against this spell. This includes appropriate Constructs regardless of creature type.

entries.name: Catastrophic Conduction
entries: If the same creature is struck three times during one casting, after resolving the third strike it takes an additional {@damage 15d12} Lightning damage with no additional saving throw. Its regeneration also stops until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Absolute Impact
entries: You compress catastrophic magical force around your body and cross the battlefield in a single instant before delivering one overwhelming blow. Choose one creature you can see within 1,000 feet. You teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it and make one melee spell attack against it. This teleportation doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Absolute Strike
entries: On a hit, the target takes {@damage 40d12} Force damage. This damage ignores Resistance to Force damage. Force Immunity instead functions as Resistance against this spell.

entries.name: Momentum Beyond Measure
entries: The farther you traveled before striking the target, the more destructive the impact becomes. If the target was at least 100 feet away, the attack deals an additional {@damage 5d12} Force damage. If the target was at least 300 feet away, the attack instead deals an additional {@damage 10d12} Force damage. If the target was at least 600 feet away, the attack instead deals an additional {@damage 15d12} Force damage. If the target was at least 900 feet away, the attack instead deals an additional {@damage 20d12} Force damage.
Use only the highest bonus that applies.

entries.name: Catastrophic Launch
entries: On a hit, the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you launch it in a direction of your choice up to 500 feet if it is Medium or smaller, 300 feet if it is Large, 200 feet if it is Huge, or 100 feet if it is Gargantuan. The creature travels in a straight line. It can be launched horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or directly into the ground.

entries.name: Collision
entries: If the target collides with a solid object, structure, terrain feature, or another creature before completing this movement, the movement ends. The launched target takes {@damage 2d12} Bludgeoning damage for every 50 feet it would have traveled after the collision, to a maximum of {@damage 20d12}. The struck object or creature takes the same damage. A creature struck this way can make a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the collision damage on a success.

entries.name: Through the Wall
entries: If the launched target collides with an object or structure and your spell's collision damage is enough to destroy that obstruction, the target continues through it. Subtract 50 feet from its remaining launch distance for each substantial obstruction it breaks through. It can therefore be hurled through walls, towers, vehicles, fortifications, cliffs, or similar structures.

entries.name: Groundbreaker
entries: If you launch the target directly into a solid surface, it takes the normal collision damage and creates a crater appropriate to the impact. If at least 200 feet of launch distance remained when it struck the surface, it takes an additional {@damage 10d12} Force damage and is knocked Prone.

entries.name: Unstoppable Blow
entries: An effect of 8th level or lower can't prevent your teleportation, redirect the attack, substitute another target, reduce the spell's Force damage to 0, or prevent forced movement caused by the spell after the target fails its saving throw.

entries.name: Massive Target
entries: Huge and Gargantuan creatures don't automatically resist the launch. If the target is Gargantuan, it has Advantage on the Strength saving throw, but on a failed save it is still moved normally according to its Size.

entries.name: Perfect Follow-Through
entries: After the target's movement ends, you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. This second teleport requires no action.

entries.name: Devastating Critical
entries: If the melee spell attack is a Critical Hit, the target also automatically fails its Strength saving throw against Catastrophic Launch.

spell.name: World-Eater's Bite
entries: You manifest the jaws of an impossible predator around a portion of the battlefield and command them to close. Choose a point you can see within range. A colossal spectral maw forms around a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. You choose any number of creatures within the area to be unaffected.

entries.name: The Bite
entries: Every affected creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 30d12} Force damage plus {@damage 20d12} Necrotic damage and is caught within the closing jaws. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't caught. The damage ignores Resistance to Force and Necrotic damage. Immunity to either damage type instead functions as Resistance against that portion of the damage.

entries.name: Crushing Jaws
entries: A creature caught by the Bite is Restrained until the end of its next turn. While Restrained this way, its Speed is 0, it can't Teleport, it can't travel to another plane, it can't become Ethereal, and it can't leave the jaws through extradimensional movement. A creature can still act normally otherwise.

entries.name: Devoured
entries: Immediately after the initial damage, choose up to three creatures that failed their saving throw. Those creatures are swallowed by the World-Eater. A swallowed creature disappears from the battlefield and enters a hostile extradimensional interior until the end of its next turn. While swallowed, it has Total Cover from everything outside, it can't affect creatures outside, creatures outside can't affect it, and it remains aware of its surroundings only as an endless crushing darkness.

entries.name: Inside the Maw
entries: At the start of a swallowed creature's turn, it takes {@damage 12d12} Necrotic damage plus {@damage 8d12} Force damage with no saving throw. It can then use its Action to attempt a Strength or Charisma saving throw, its choice. On a success, it tears open an exit and immediately appears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 30 feet of the spell's original center.

entries.name: Final Crush
entries: At the end of a swallowed creature's next turn, if it is still inside the World-Eater, the jaws collapse around it. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 20d12} Force damage and is expelled Prone into the nearest unoccupied space to the spell's original center. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is expelled without being knocked Prone. The spell then ends for that creature.

entries.name: Sever the Battlefield
entries: Objects and structures within the original sphere automatically fail their saving throws and take maximum damage from The Bite. Walls, buildings, fortifications, vehicles, and magical structures take double damage. You decide which portions of the terrain are affected. The jaws can tear a building in half, bite through a fortress wall, remove the upper portion of a tower, carve a crater into the earth, or separate a section of terrain from its surroundings.

entries.name: Missing Piece
entries: Nonmagical unattended material destroyed by The Bite is consumed, leaving empty space rather than debris. This can't consume an Artifact.

entries.name: Bite the Immovable
entries: Huge and Gargantuan creatures can be swallowed normally. A creature doesn't gain Advantage on its saving throw merely because of its Size. If a creature is too large to fit entirely inside the original sphere, it can still be affected as long as at least half its space lies within the sphere.

entries.name: No Lesser Escape
entries: An effect of 8th level or lower can't force open the jaws, teleport a swallowed creature out, move it to another plane, dispel the extradimensional interior, or substitute another creature in its place. An Artifact, appropriate 9th-level effect, deity, or comparable power can interfere normally.

entries.name: Eaten Alive
entries: If a swallowed creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points while inside the World-Eater, you choose whether it is expelled normally or remains within the extradimensional interior until the spell ends. If it dies there, its body and possessions are expelled when the spell ends.

spell.name: Martial Incarnation
entries: Armor closes around you, and weapons answer your grasp with the instincts of a seasoned warrior. You become a supernatural martial combatant and manifest magical armaments. This spell doesn't require Concentration.
When cast using a higher-level spell slot, you gain all benefits provided by lower-level castings unless a higher-level benefit explicitly replaces one of them.

entries.name: Martial Armament
entries: When you cast the spell, you can manifest up to two pieces of equipment, choosing separately from the following:

items: One Simple or Martial Melee Weapon.
One Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon.
One Shield.
One suit of Light Armor.
One suit of Medium Armor.
One suit of Heavy Armor.

entries: The equipment appears already held, worn, or equipped by you as appropriate. Armor and Shields manifested by the spell are donned instantly. Every weapon, suit of armor, and Shield created by this spell is magical from the moment it manifests. All manifested equipment disappears when the spell ends.

entries.name: Incarnation Enhancement
entries: Every weapon, suit of armor, and Shield manifested by this spell gains a magical enhancement based on the spell slot used.

A manifested weapon adds the bonus to its attack and damage rolls. Manifested armor adds the bonus to its AC. A manifested Shield grants its normal +2 AC plus the Incarnation Enhancement. Special Incarnate Armaments use the same Incarnation Enhancement.

entries.name: Martial Mastery
entries: For the duration, you have proficiency with all Simple Weapons, all Martial Weapons, Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, and Shields. You ignore the Strength requirement of armor manifested by this spell. You can use Strength, Dexterity, or your spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls made with weapons manifested by this spell. You choose separately for each attack.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: You can use the Weapon Mastery property of every weapon manifested by this spell. Whenever you manifest a weapon, you can replace its normal Mastery property with one of the following: Cleave, Graze, Nick, Push, Sap, Slow, Topple, or Vex. For purposes of Martial Incarnation, you don't need to satisfy the normal weapon prerequisite for the chosen Mastery.

entries.name: Warrior's Form
entries: When you cast the spell, choose Strength or Dexterity. If the chosen score is lower than 16, it becomes 16 for the duration. You also gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 5 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Any Temporary Hit Points remaining from this spell disappear when the spell ends.

entries.name: Living Weapon
entries: Your body itself can serve as one of your manifested weapons. For the duration, your Unarmed Strikes are magical and deal {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, chosen for each attack. You can use Strength, Dexterity, or your spellcasting ability for their attack and damage rolls. Your Unarmed Strikes add your Incarnation Enhancement to their attack and damage rolls and count as Martial Weapons for features granted by this spell.

Whenever you make an Unarmed Strike, you can give it one of these Masteries: Graze, Push, Sap, Slow, Topple, or Vex. The strike can appear as an ordinary punch, kick, elbow, knee, headbutt, or another martial motion. The spell doesn't need to visibly transform your body unless you choose it to.

entries.name: Unarmored Incarnation
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, your base AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier or spellcasting ability modifier + your Incarnation Enhancement. Choose Dexterity or your spellcasting ability when you cast the spell. You can use a Shield with this AC unless another feature specifically requires you to be completely unarmored and unshielded.

entries.name: 2nd-Level Slot — Complete Armament
entries: You can manifest up to three pieces of equipment. The ability chosen for Warrior's Form becomes 17 if lower.
Choose one Fighting Style for the duration:

items: {@b Archery.} You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with Ranged weapons.
{@b Defense.} While wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
{@b Dueling.} While wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
{@b Great Weapon Fighting.} When you roll a 1 on a damage die for an attack made with a melee weapon you are wielding with two hands, treat the roll as a 2.
{@b Two-Weapon Fighting.} When you make the additional attack granted by fighting with two Light weapons, you can add your ability modifier to its damage.
{@b Unarmed Fighting.} Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 1d10} while you aren't wielding a weapon or Shield.

entries.name: 3rd-Level Slot — Warrior Incarnate
entries: You can manifest up to four pieces of equipment. The ability chosen for Warrior's Form becomes 18 if lower. When you take the Attack action, you can attack twice instead of once. Your Temporary Hit Points from the spell instead equal 10 + twice your spellcasting ability modifier.

entries.name: Martial Body
entries: Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 1d10} whether or not you wield other equipment. While you aren't wearing armor, you gain an additional +1 AC. Standing from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement, and your jump distance doubles.

entries.name: Fluid Mastery
entries: Before each attack with a manifested weapon or Unarmed Strike, you can change its chosen Mastery property, no action required.

entries.name: Arcsteel Blade
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 1d10} Slashing
{@b Properties:} Finesse, Versatile ({@damage 1d12})
Before each attack, you can choose for the blade to deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

entries.name: 5th Level — Adaptive Edge
entries: You can additionally choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. The blade visibly changes its structure to reflect its current damage type.

entries.name: 7th Level — Perfect Edge
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 2d10}. After you know whether an attack hits, but before dealing damage, you can choose the attack's damage type. The attack ignores Resistance to that damage type.

entries.name: 9th Level — Absolute Edge
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8}. You can choose any damage type before dealing damage. Its attacks ignore Resistance, and Immunity to the chosen damage type is treated as Resistance.

entries.name: Warcaster Spear
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 1d8} Piercing
{@b Properties:} Reach, Thrown (30/120), Versatile ({@damage 1d10})
Immediately after making a thrown attack with the spear, it returns to your hand.

entries.name: 5th Level — Piercing Flight
entries: Its thrown range becomes 120/360. After hitting a target with a thrown attack, you can make another attack with the same throw against one creature directly behind the first target.

entries.name: 7th Level — Transfix
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 2d8}. When you hit a creature, you can attempt to pin it to a surface within 10 feet behind it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have Speed 0 until it uses an Action to free itself.

entries.name: 9th Level — World Lance
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8}, and its thrown range becomes Sight. Once on each of your turns, when you throw the spear, it can continue through every creature and object intersecting a straight line from you. Make a separate attack roll against each target.

entries.name: Spellbow
entries: {@i Martial Ranged Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 1d10} Piercing
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
The weapon creates its own magical ammunition.

entries.name: 5th Level — Shaped Ammunition
entries: Before each attack, choose one:

items: {@b Piercing Arrow.} The attack ignores Half Cover.
{@b Burst Arrow.} On a hit, creatures of your choice within 5 feet of the target take damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
{@b Binding Arrow.} On a hit, the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: 7th Level — Spellshot
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 2d10}, and its range becomes 300/1,200. Before each attack, choose Piercing, Force, or Radiant damage.

entries.name: 9th Level — Arcane Ballista
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8}, and its range becomes Sight. You can apply two different Shaped Ammunition options to each attack.

entries.name: 4th-Level Slot — Martial Discipline
entries: You can manifest up to five pieces of equipment.
Choose one Martial Discipline for the duration:

items: {@b Assault.} Every time you hit with a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, the attack deals an additional {@damage 1d8} damage of its damage type.
{@b Guardian.} While wielding a Shield, you gain an additional +1 AC. Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks from you even when they take the Disengage action.
{@b Skirmisher.} Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
{@b Executioner.} Your weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
{@b Pugilist.} Whenever you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you can immediately attempt to Grapple or Shove the target as part of the same attack.
{@b Counterfighter.} When a creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to make one Unarmed Strike against it.
{@b Iron Body.} While wearing no armor and wielding no Shield, you gain an additional +2 AC.
{@b Flowing Form.} While you aren't wearing armor, your Speed increases by 15 feet. Moving through the space of a creature at least one Size larger than you doesn't cost extra movement.

entries.name: Bastion Plate
entries: {@i Heavy Armor}
{@b Base AC:} 18
You have Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved against your will. Its Incarnation Enhancement is added normally.

entries.name: Aegis Shield
entries: {@i Shield}
The Shield grants its normal +2 AC plus its Incarnation Enhancement. When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce that damage by {@damage 1d10} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

entries.name: Skirmisher Mail
entries: {@i Medium Armor}
{@b Base AC:} 15 + Dexterity modifier, maximum +3
It doesn't impose Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: 5th-Level Slot — Veteran Armament
entries: There is no longer a limit on the number of weapons you can manifest. You can still maintain only one suit of armor and one Shield. The ability chosen for Warrior's Form becomes 19 if lower. You gain proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws.

entries.name: Veteran Strike
entries: Every time you hit with a manifested weapon or Unarmed Strike, the attack deals an additional {@damage 2d8} damage of the attack's damage type. Veteran Strike replaces Assault's additional damage.

entries.name: Instant Arsenal
entries: Before or after any attack, you can replace one manifested weapon with another weapon available to this spell, no action required.

entries.name: Greater Living Weapon
entries: Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 2d6}. You can choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Force damage for each strike.

entries.name: Crushing Hold
entries: At the start of each of your turns, choose one creature you are Grappling. It takes {@damage 2d8} + the ability modifier used for the Grapple as Bludgeoning or Force damage, your choice.

entries.name: Colossus Blade
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d8}
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed, Reach
Choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage whenever you manifest it.

entries.name: 7th Level — Titanic Reach
entries: Its damage becomes {@damage 2d10}. Each time you hit with it during your turn, its Reach increases by 5 feet until the end of that turn.

entries.name: 9th Level — Colossal Sweep
entries: Its damage becomes {@damage 4d10}. Once on each of your turns, instead of attacking a single target, you can make one attack roll and compare it against the AC of every creature of your choice within the weapon's current reach. Each creature hit takes the attack's full damage.

entries.name: Twinblade
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 1d8} Slashing
{@b Properties:} Finesse, Light
When you take the Attack action and attack with Twinblade, you can make one additional Twinblade attack as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: 7th Level — Accelerating Blades
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 2d6}. Each consecutive Twinblade hit against the same creature during your turn gains a cumulative +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: 9th Level — Infinite Combination
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 3d6}. The first additional Twinblade attack you make on each of your turns requires no Bonus Action. Whenever you score a Critical Hit with Twinblade, you can immediately make one additional Twinblade attack.

entries.name: Siege Bow
entries: {@i Martial Ranged Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d8} Piercing
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
The weapon creates its own magical ammunition. Its attacks deal double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: 7th Level — Siege Charge
entries: When you hit, you can delay that attack's damage until the end of your turn. Multiple delayed hits can be stored in the same target. At the end of your turn, all stored Siege Charges detonate, dealing their stored damage separately.

entries.name: 9th Level — Fortress Breaker
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d10} Force or Piercing, chosen for each attack. It deals triple damage to objects and structures. It can directly damage magical barriers, Force constructions, conjured structures, and similar manifestations.

entries.name: 6th-Level Slot — Relentless Warrior
entries: The ability chosen for Warrior's Form becomes 20 if lower. You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. When damage would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this occurs, it can't occur again during that casting.

entries.name: Adamant Body
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, you have Advantage on checks and saves made to resist being Grappled, Shoved, physically Restrained, or forcibly moved.

entries.name: Barehanded Deflection
entries: When you are hit by a weapon attack, you can use your Reaction to reduce its damage by {@damage 2d10} + your spellcasting ability modifier + your character level. If this reduces the damage to 0 and the attacker is within your Unarmed Strike reach, you can immediately make one Unarmed Strike against it.

entries.name: Spellbreaker
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d8} Force
{@b Properties:} Finesse

When you damage a creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on its Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration against that damage. Spellbreaker can damage magical barriers, Force manifestations, and magical constructions.

entries.name: 7th Level — Interdict
entries: When a creature within your reach casts a spell, you can use your Reaction to attack it with Spellbreaker before the spell resolves. On a hit, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the spell fails, while the spell slot and any expended components are still consumed.

entries.name: 9th Level — Devour the Formula
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8} Force. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature affected by a spell, you can attempt to end one spell affecting it as though using {@spell Dispel Magic}, using your spellcasting ability. If you successfully end the spell, your next Spellbreaker hit before the end of your next turn deals an additional {@damage 3d10} Force damage.

entries.name: Juggernaut Plate
entries: {@i Heavy Armor}
{@b Base AC:} 19

Your Speed isn't reduced by this armor. While wearing it, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost extra movement. You count as one Size larger for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. You count as one Size larger when determining what creatures you can Grapple or Shove.

entries.name: Guardian Aegis
entries: {@i Shield}
In addition to its normal AC bonus and Incarnation Enhancement, creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you have Half Cover while you wield this Shield.

entries.name: 7th-Level Slot — Master of Arms
entries: When you take the Attack action, you can make three attacks instead of two.

entries.name: Master Strike
entries: Every time you hit with a manifested weapon or Unarmed Strike, the attack deals an additional {@damage 3d8} damage. Master Strike replaces Veteran Strike.

entries.name: Master of Technique
entries: Whenever you hit with a manifested weapon, you can apply two different Weapon Mastery properties to the attack. An individual Mastery can't be applied twice to the same attack. Your Unarmed Strikes can likewise apply two different Masteries from their available list.

entries.name: Master of the Body
entries: Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 2d8}. Your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 5 feet. Once during each of your turns, before or after an Unarmed Strike, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Throw
entries: When you successfully Grapple or Shove a creature, you can instead throw it up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. The creature falls Prone. If it collides with a creature or solid object, both take {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Severing Edge
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d10} Force
{@b Properties:} Finesse, Reach
Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature, you can sever one of the following until the start of your next turn:

items: A telepathic connection.
A magical tether.
A Shared Damage or Shared Hit Point connection.
A creature's connection to a summoned creature it controls.
A supernatural link allowing another creature to perceive through it.
A magical control connection between the target and another creature.

entries: If none applies, the attack instead deals an additional {@damage 3d10} Force damage.

entries.name: 8th Level — Deeper Severance
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 3d10} Force. You can additionally interrupt possession, teleportation links, shared magical effects, supernatural command bonds, and other comparable active connections.

entries.name: 9th Level — Cut the Connection
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d10} Force. A connection you sever remains interrupted until the end of your next turn instead of the start.

entries.name: Meteor Hammer
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
Whenever you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet. On a Critical Hit, it also falls Prone.

entries.name: 8th Level — Meteor Impact
entries: Its damage becomes {@damage 3d10}. You can push a creature up to 15 feet on every hit.

entries.name: 9th Level — Falling Heaven
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d12} Bludgeoning. Once on each of your turns when you hit, choose a point on the ground within 10 feet of the target. A 20-foot-radius shockwave erupts there. Other creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d10} Bludgeoning damage, falls Prone, and is pushed 15 feet away from the impact. On a successful save, it takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

entries.name: Horizon Bow
entries: {@i Martial Ranged Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 2d10} Piercing
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
The weapon creates its own ammunition. Its attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Long range doesn't impose Disadvantage.

entries.name: 8th Level — Beyond the Horizon
entries: Its range becomes Sight. Cover short of Total Cover grants no benefit against its attacks.

entries.name: 9th Level — Unerring Horizon
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d10} Piercing or Force. Once on each of your turns, you can make one Horizon Bow attack with Advantage, regardless of distance.

entries.name: 8th-Level Slot — Legendary Combatant
entries: You gain two Martial Disciplines instead of one. You gain one additional Reaction each round, regained at the start of each of your turns. That additional Reaction can be used only for an Opportunity Attack, a defensive feature granted by this spell, or a feature of this spell triggered by another creature attacking or moving. Your weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on 19–20. If you have Executioner, they instead score a Critical Hit on 18–20.

entries.name: Legendary Strike
entries: Every hit with a manifested weapon or Unarmed Strike deals an additional {@damage 4d8} damage. Legendary Strike replaces Master Strike.

entries.name: Legendary Panoply
entries: At any point during your turn, you can freely change your manifested weapons, manifested Shield, or manifested armor, no action required.

entries.name: Legendary Body
entries: Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 3d8}. While wearing no armor and wielding no Shield, you gain an additional +3 AC, Critical Hits against you become normal hits, you can't be knocked Prone against your will while conscious, and your Speed increases by another 10 feet.

entries.name: Empty-Hand Counter
entries: When a creature within your Unarmed Strike reach attacks you, leaves your reach, attempts to Grapple you, or attempts to move you against your will, you can use a Reaction to make one Unarmed Strike against it before the triggering effect resolves. If the attack hits, you can immediately attempt to Grapple or Shove it.

entries.name: Riftblade
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 3d8} Force
{@b Properties:} Finesse
You can make melee weapon attacks with Riftblade against a target you can see within 30 feet. The blade cuts the intervening distance rather than traveling through it.

entries.name: 9th Level — Spatial Dominion
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8} Force, and its range becomes 120 feet.
Whenever you hit, choose one:

items: {@b Fold.} You appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target.
{@b Displace.} Move the target up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
{@b Rend.} The target suffers a spatial wound until the start of your next turn. If it teleports during that time, it takes {@damage 4d10} Force damage immediately after arriving.

entries.name: Starfall Bow
entries: {@i Martial Ranged Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 3d8} Radiant or Force
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
Choose Radiant or Force damage for each attack. The weapon creates its own ammunition. Its attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover, and long range doesn't impose Disadvantage.

entries.name: 9th Level — Celestial Barrage
entries: Its weapon damage becomes {@damage 4d8}. Once on each of your turns when you hit, you can call down a barrage centered on the target. Creatures of your choice within 20 feet of it make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d12} Radiant or Force damage, your choice. On a success, it takes half damage. The primary target isn't affected by this additional burst.

entries.name: Fortress Plate
entries: {@i Heavy Armor}
{@b Base AC:} 20

While wearing it, you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. You can't be moved against your will while conscious unless you choose to be. Critical Hits against you become normal hits.

entries.name: Mirror Aegis
entries: {@i Shield}
When a creature within 60 feet misses you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to cause the Shield to retaliate. The attacker takes {@damage 2d10} Force damage.

entries.name: 9th-Level Slot — Perfect Martial Incarnation
entries: Your Strength and Dexterity scores both become 22 if lower. When you take the Attack action, you can make four attacks. You gain all Martial Disciplines.

entries.name: Perfect Mastery
entries: Before or after making an attack roll with a manifested weapon, you can freely choose its Mastery properties. When an attack hits, you can apply up to three different Mastery properties to it. Your Unarmed Strikes can likewise apply up to three different available Unarmed Masteries.

entries.name: Perfect Panoply
entries: You can simultaneously maintain one suit of armor, one Shield, and any number of manifested weapons. Weapons not currently wielded can remain suspended within your Martial Incarnation and appear directly in an empty hand whenever you wish, no action required. Every manifested piece has a +6 Incarnation Enhancement.

entries.name: Apex Strike
entries: Every time you hit with a manifested weapon or Unarmed Strike, the attack deals an additional {@damage 5d8} damage. Apex Strike replaces Assault, Veteran Strike, Master Strike, and Legendary Strike.

entries.name: Unbroken Warrior
entries: At the start of each of your turns, if you have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain {@damage 2d10} Hit Points.

entries.name: Perfect Technique
entries: Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you can cause that attack to hit instead.

entries.name: Unyielding
entries: Whenever you fail a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll.

entries.name: Perfect Living Weapon
entries: Your Unarmed Strike damage becomes {@damage 4d8}. Choose Bludgeoning, Force, Piercing, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder damage for each attack.

entries.name: Perfect Empty Hand
entries: While wearing no armor and wielding neither a weapon nor Shield, your base AC becomes 18 + your Dexterity modifier or spellcasting ability modifier + your Incarnation Enhancement. Your Speed increases by 30 feet. Your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 10 feet. You can move across liquids and vertical surfaces during your turn without falling during that movement. You can't be forcibly moved or knocked Prone while conscious unless you choose to be. You can Grapple creatures of any Size.
Your Unarmed Strikes ignore Resistance, and Immunity to their damage is treated as Resistance.

entries.name: Heavenbreaker
entries: Once on each of your turns, before making an Unarmed Strike, you can declare it a Heavenbreaker. On a hit, the attack deals an additional {@damage 4d12} Force damage. A Heavenbreaker ignores Resistance and Immunity to all damage dealt by the attack. It can damage creatures, objects, structures, magical barriers, Force effects, supernatural manifestations, magical prisons, seals, conjured terrain, and similar effects. It can damage something described as indestructible, immune to all damage, or normally incapable of taking damage.

It doesn't require any particular weapon, material, spell, damage type, Artifact, alignment, creature type, or other special method to harm its target. Its damage can't be redirected to another target in place of the thing struck.

entries.name: Break the Unbreakable
entries: Heavenbreaker deals damage normally to targets with Hit Points. If a target lacks AC or Hit Points because it normally can't be damaged, the DM assigns appropriate values based on its scale and power. Sufficient damage can then destroy it; Heavenbreaker doesn't destroy it automatically.

entries.name: Godslayer
entries: {@i Martial Melee Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 4d8}
{@b Properties:} Finesse, Reach

Before each attack, choose any damage type. Godslayer's attacks ignore Resistance and Immunity to their damage. They ignore requirements for a specific weapon, material, damage type, spell, alignment, Artifact, or other special means of harming a creature. They can harm creatures that would otherwise be impossible to damage by conventional means.

entries.name: Mortal Principle
entries: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with Godslayer, choose one defensive feature possessed by that creature. Until the start of your next turn, that feature doesn't function against you. Examples include Regeneration, Damage Resistance, Damage Immunity, Legendary Resistance, damage reduction, a feature preventing death at 0 Hit Points, or a feature limiting how much damage the creature can take from an attack or turn. The feature isn't removed from the creature and continues functioning against everyone else.

entries.name: Worldpiercer
entries: {@i Martial Ranged Weapon}
{@b Damage:} {@damage 4d8} Force
{@b Range:} Sight
{@b Properties:} Heavy, Two-Handed
Worldpiercer creates its own ammunition.

entries.name: Penetration
entries: Its projectile doesn't stop after striking its first target. When you attack, choose a straight line extending from you through the original target. Make a separate attack roll against every creature, object, barrier, and structure intersected by that line. There is no inherent limit on the number of targets the projectile can strike.

entries.name: Worldline Shot
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can designate one Worldpiercer attack as a Worldline Shot. Its damage ignores Resistance and Immunity and can damage normally indestructible obstacles. The projectile continues only if it penetrates or destroys enough of each obstacle to pass through.

entries.name: Invincible Panoply
entries: {@i Heavy Armor}
{@b Base AC:} 21

With its +6 Incarnation Enhancement, its AC becomes 27. While wearing it, Critical Hits against you become normal hits. You can't be forcibly moved or knocked Prone while conscious unless you choose to be. You have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. You have Resistance to Force damage. Your Speed can't be reduced below half its normal value.

entries.name: Absolute Aegis
entries: {@i Shield}
The Shield grants its normal +2 AC plus its +6 Incarnation Enhancement, for +8 AC total.
When you are hit by an attack or fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your Reaction and choose one:

items: {@b Deflect.} The triggering attack misses you instead.
{@b Shelter.} You succeed on the triggering Dexterity saving throw instead.

entries: Once you use either option, you can't use Absolute Aegis this way again until the start of your next turn.

spell.name: Catastrophic Vector
entries: You seize the direction of a creature's momentum and violently rewrite it.

entries.name: Vector Reversal
entries: Choose one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 8d12} Force damage and is hurled up to 60 feet in a direction of your choice. If the target collides with a creature, object, or solid surface before traveling the full distance, it stops and both the target and whatever it collided with take {@damage 4d12} Bludgeoning damage.

A creature struck by the hurled target can make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking no collision damage on a successful save and moving to the nearest unoccupied space if necessary. On a successful save, the target takes half as much Force damage and isn't moved.

entries.name: Massive Impact
entries: If the target is moved at least 30 feet before colliding with a solid surface or creature, increase the collision damage to {@damage 6d12}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 6 or higher, the initial Force damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d12|5-9|2d12} for each slot level above 5.

spell.name: Severing Edge

components.m: a weapon worth at least 1 SP

entries: You draw a razor-thin line of force along the weapon in your hand, sharpening the next strike beyond the limits of steel.

entries.name: Severing Strike
entries: As part of casting this spell, make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting against a creature within the weapon's reach or range. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and the attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. If the target has Immunity to the weapon's Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, treat that Immunity as Resistance against this attack instead.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: At character level 5, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d10} Force damage. At character level 11, the extra Force damage becomes {@damage 2d10}, and the attack also ignores Resistance to Force damage. At character level 17, the extra Force damage becomes {@damage 3d10}, and if the target has Immunity to Force damage, treat that Immunity as Resistance for this attack.

spell.name: Ricochet Shot

components.m: a ranged weapon worth at least 1 SP

entries: Your projectile twists after impact, seeking another target along an impossible path.

entries.name: Ricochet
entries: As part of casting this spell, make one attack with the ranged weapon used in the spell's casting. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage. You can then cause the projectile to ricochet toward another creature you can see within 20 feet of the first target and make another attack roll with the same weapon against that creature. A ricochet uses the same weapon and ammunition, doesn't expend additional ammunition, can't target a creature already targeted by this casting, and ignores Half Cover created by the previous target.
The ricochet ends if an attack misses.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: At character level 5, the first attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage, and the projectile can ricochet once. At character level 11, the extra Force damage becomes {@damage 2d8}, and the projectile can ricochet up to twice, each time to a new creature within 20 feet of the previous target. At character level 17, the extra Force damage becomes {@damage 3d8}, and the projectile can ricochet up to three times.
Each successful ricochet attack deals the weapon's normal damage, but the extra Force damage from this spell is dealt only by the first attack.

spell.name: Gravity Nail

components.m: a melee weapon worth at least 1 SP

entries: Your strike pins gravity around its target, making every step heavier.

entries.name: Gravity Zone
entries: As part of casting this spell, make one melee attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and a 10-foot-radius Gravity Zone appears centered on the target until the start of your next turn.

items: The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures.
The first time on a turn that a hostile creature willingly moves 5 feet or more within the zone, it takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage.
A hostile creature can't benefit from a Flying Speed while in the zone unless it can hover.
Forced movement affecting a hostile creature in the zone is reduced by 10 feet, to a minimum of 0 feet.

entries: The zone moves with the target.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: At character level 5, the weapon attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage, and the movement damage becomes {@damage 2d8}. At character level 11, the extra weapon damage becomes {@damage 2d8}, the movement damage becomes {@damage 3d8}, and hostile creatures in the zone have Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made to resist being Grappled, Shoved, or moved.

At character level 17, the extra weapon damage becomes {@damage 3d8}, the movement damage becomes {@damage 4d8}, and a hostile creature that starts its turn in the zone must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

spell.name: Bloodedge
entries: A crimson pulse beats within the weapon, feeding on wounds and faltering hearts.

entries.name: Sanguine Weapon
entries: Touch one weapon. For the duration, attacks made with it deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage. Whenever the weapon deals this extra damage to a creature, the wielder gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your spellcasting ability modifier. This benefit can occur on every hit. If you stop holding the weapon, the spell remains on it until the end of your next turn before ending.

entries.name: Exploding Blood
entries: Whenever a Necrotic damage die granted by this spell is at the maximum possible value of that die, roll one additional die of the same size and add it to the damage. An additional die rolled this way can also explode if it is at the maximum possible value of that die. You can roll a maximum number of additional dice from this feature equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1) per attack.

entries.name: Blood Drain
entries: Once on each turn when the affected weapon deals Necrotic damage to a creature, the wielder can regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt by this spell. If the wielder is already at its Hit Point maximum, it instead gains that amount as Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Scent of Weakness
entries: Against a creature below half its Hit Point maximum, each Necrotic damage die from this spell can't roll lower than 4, and the affected weapon scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Against a creature at or below one-quarter of its Hit Point maximum, the original Necrotic damage dice from this spell are maximized instead. Those maximized dice still trigger Exploding Blood.

entries.name: Feast on the Fallen
entries: When the affected weapon reduces a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, the wielder immediately regains Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus, gains the same amount of Temporary Hit Points, and can end one of the following conditions on itself: Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, or Stunned. This benefit can trigger only once per turn.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: At character level 5, the extra Necrotic damage becomes {@damage 2d8}. At character level 11, the extra Necrotic damage becomes {@damage 3d8}. In addition, once on each of your turns when at least one Necrotic damage die from this spell explodes, you can immediately make one additional attack with the affected weapon against a creature within its reach or range. This attack requires no Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction and can benefit from Bloodedge, but it can't trigger this additional attack again that turn.

At character level 17, the extra Necrotic damage becomes {@damage 4d8}. Against a creature below half its Hit Point maximum, the affected weapon scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20, and Blood Drain restores Hit Points equal to the full Necrotic damage dealt by this spell instead of half. When the level 11 additional attack triggers, you can make two additional attacks instead of one, against the same creature or different creatures.

entries.name: Unending Hunger
entries: At character level 17, when the affected weapon reduces a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this spell's duration resets to 1 minute.

spell.name: Dawnedge
entries: Dawnlight burns beneath the weapon's surface, gathering strength as your foe falters.

entries.name: Luminous Weapon
entries: Touch one weapon. For the duration, attacks made with it deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage. Whenever the weapon deals this extra damage to a creature, the wielder gains Radiance equal to the number of Radiant damage dice granted by this spell that are at their maximum possible value. The wielder can hold a maximum amount of Radiance equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1). All Radiance is lost when the spell ends. If you stop holding the weapon, the spell remains on it until the end of your next turn before ending.

entries.name: Overflowing Light
entries: Whenever a Radiant damage die granted by this spell is at the maximum possible value of that die, roll one additional die of the same size and add it to the damage. An additional die gained this way can also trigger this feature. You can roll a maximum number of additional dice from this feature equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1) per attack.

entries.name: Spend Radiance
entries: Whenever the affected weapon hits a creature, the wielder can expend any amount of stored Radiance. For each Radiance expended, choose one of the following effects. You can choose the same effect more than once.

items: {@b Burn.} Deal an additional {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage.
{@b Mend.} The wielder regains {@dice 1d8} Hit Points.
{@b Ward.} The wielder gains {@dice 1d8} Temporary Hit Points.

{@b Purify.} The wielder ends one of the following conditions on itself for every 2 Radiance expended: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

entries.name: Light Finds the Weak
entries: Against a creature below half its Hit Point maximum, each Radiant damage die granted by this spell can't be lower than 4. Against a creature at or below one-quarter of its Hit Point maximum, the original Radiant damage dice granted by this spell are maximized instead. Those maximized dice still trigger Overflowing Light, and the affected weapon scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

entries.name: Judgment of Dawn
entries: Once on each turn when the affected weapon scores a Critical Hit or reduces a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, the wielder gains Radiance equal to your Proficiency Bonus, up to the normal maximum. In addition, it can immediately end one of the following conditions on itself: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.

entries.name: Light of Dawn
entries: While the spell is active, the affected weapon sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The wielder can reduce either radius to 0 or restore it at any time without an action. The light can be any warm hue chosen when the spell is cast.

entries.name: Revealing Glow
entries: As an Action, the wielder can hold the weapon near a creature, object, or surface within 5 feet. Until the end of the wielder's next turn, the light reveals fresh blood; poison or corruption visibly present on a surface; hidden writing, markings, or residue that would become visible under strong light; and whether an object is emitting magical light or ordinary light. This doesn't automatically reveal Invisible creatures, secret doors, curses, or hidden magic.

entries.name: Gentle Radiance
entries: While holding the weapon, the wielder can use the light to perform simple noncombat effects such as drying damp clothing or a small wet object over several minutes; warming food, drink, or a Tiny object; sterilizing ordinary grime from a Tiny object or a small wound; creating a harmless glowing mark or symbol on a surface that lasts until the spell ends; or causing the weapon's glow to pulse, dim, or flash as a visible signal.
These effects can't deal damage, restore Hit Points, remove conditions, or replace a spell that would normally be required for a larger magical effect.

entries.name: Beacon of Hope
entries: A willing creature within 10 feet of the affected weapon can always tell which direction the weapon is in while it remains within 300 feet. The wielder can suppress or restore this effect at any time.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: At character level 5, the extra Radiant damage becomes {@damage 2d8}. At character level 11, the extra Radiant damage becomes {@damage 3d8}. Once on each of your turns when at least one Radiant damage die from this spell triggers Overflowing Light, the wielder can immediately expend 1 Radiance without reducing its stored Radiance.

At character level 17, the extra Radiant damage becomes {@damage 4d8}. Against a creature below half its Hit Point maximum, the affected weapon scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20, and every point of Radiance spent on Burn, Mend, or Ward produces two dice instead of one. In addition, whenever Judgment of Dawn triggers, the wielder can immediately make one additional attack with the affected weapon against a creature within its reach or range. This attack requires no Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction and can't trigger another additional attack from this feature during the same turn.

entries.name: Everlasting Dawn
entries: At character level 17, whenever the affected weapon reduces a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this spell's duration resets to 1 minute.

spell.name: Shifting Strike

components.m: a weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: You channel volatile magic through a weapon and strike with an element of your choosing. As part of casting this spell, make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting. You use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack hits, choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, or Thunder. The attack's damage becomes the chosen type instead of its normal damage type.

entries.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the chosen type when you reach level 5, {@damage 2d6} at level 11, and {@damage 3d6} at level 17. You choose the damage type each time you cast the spell.

spell.name: Umbral Refuge
entries: Your shadow deepens, carrying sheltered companions as dark silhouettes beneath your feet. Touch up to four willing creatures other than yourself. Each merges into your shadow with its worn and carried equipment for the duration.

entries.name: Within the Shadow
entries: A sheltered creature has Total Cover against everything outside your shadow, doesn't need to breathe, and moves with you without using its movement or counting against your carrying capacity. It can see and hear from your space and communicate telepathically with you and the other sheltered creatures. A sheltered creature can't take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions, except the Bonus Action to emerge described below. It can maintain Concentration, and any ongoing effects on it continue normally.

entries.name: Emergence
entries: As a Bonus Action, you can release any number of sheltered creatures. A sheltered creature can also use a Bonus Action to release itself. Each released creature appears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of you, and the spell ends for it. If no such space is available, it remains sheltered. When the spell ends, all remaining sheltered creatures appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces of their choice outside your space.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can shelter two additional creatures for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Witness in the Grain

components.m: a clear glass lens

entries: Beneath your palm, an object's scratches and stains unfold into scenes of its past.

Touch an object no larger than a 10-foot Cube that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. Choose a time within the past seven days, or describe an event that occurred during that period, such as "the last time someone opened this chest." If you describe an event, the spell finds its most recent occurrence. If no matching event occurred, you learn that fact, and the spell ends.

entries.name: Recorded Scene
entries: You perceive a reconstruction of the object's surroundings, beginning at the chosen time or up to 1 minute before the event. The scene includes sights and sounds within 30 feet of the object, viewed from its position at that time. It doesn't reveal anything behind Total Cover or expose invisible creatures, disguises, or illusions. The scene appears as a translucent projection in a 10-foot Cube within 5 feet of you. Creatures viewing it can see and hear the reconstruction. Recorded speech is reproduced in its original language.

entries.name: Read the Record
entries: For the duration, you can pause, rewind, or advance the scene without taking an action, examining any moment within 10 minutes before or after its starting point. You can rotate the viewpoint around the object's position, but can't move it elsewhere. The spell reveals only what occurred around the object. It doesn't reveal thoughts, intentions, or events from before the object existed.

spell.name: Thunder Incarnate
entries: Lightning fills a willing body, transforming it into a living storm.
Touch one willing creature, which can be yourself. For the duration, the target and everything it is wearing or carrying transform into a coherent storm, granting it the following benefits:

entries.name: Storm Body
entries: The target has a Fly Speed of 90 feet and can hover. It has Immunity to Lightning damage and Resistance to Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing and retains the ability to speak, cast spells, and use its equipment.

entries.name: Living Lightning
entries: The target's movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. It can move through other creatures' spaces without treating those spaces as Difficult Terrain, but can't willingly end its movement there.

The first time the target enters another creature's space on each of the target's turns, it can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} Lightning damage and can't take Reactions until the start of the target's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect. The target can affect up to five creatures this way on each of its turns.

entries.name: Stormcharged Strikes
entries: Whenever the target deals damage to a creature with an attack or a spell, it deals an extra {@damage 2d8} Lightning or Thunder damage (its choice) to that creature.

entries.name: Thunderous Departure
entries: Immediately after you cast this spell, the target can use its Reaction to move up to half its Fly Speed. If you are the target, you can make this movement without taking a Reaction.
If the spell ends while the target occupies a space too small for its normal form, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space that can accommodate it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
