The first Saving Throw each turn that a hostile creature in the aura makes against one of the greatwyrm's Enchantment or Illusion effects is made with Disadvantage. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, its Poison Breath automatically recharges.
While The Emerald Masquerade is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Web of the Verdant Lie
entries: Green dragons understand that controlling what someone believes is often more useful than controlling their body. They collect promises, weaknesses, fears, alliances, and secrets with the same appetite other dragons reserve for gold. At great age, simply dealing with one becomes dangerous long before initiative is rolled.

entries.name: Borrowed Voice
entries: Reproducing a learned voice or sound requires an Action. The dragon remembers the learned voice or sound indefinitely. After hearing a voice or sound for at least 1 minute, the dragon can reproduce it. A creature suspicious of the imitation can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC. This doesn't provide perfect supernatural identity copying.

entries.name: Venomous Bargain
entries: This effect lasts for 24 hours. When a creature willingly makes an explicit promise to the dragon, the dragon can mystically mark that promise. If the dragon later actually learns that the creature knowingly broke the promise during the duration, it can trigger the mark. The creature takes {@damage 4d8} Poison plus {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage, and the dragon knows its direction for 1 hour while both remain on the same plane. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must genuinely learn that the promise was broken.

entries.name: Web of Influence
entries: After speaking with a creature for at least 1 minute, the dragon can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check opposed by the creature's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. On a success, the dragon learns one broad current reasonably exposed by the creature's behavior: a fear, desire, important loyalty, or immediate goal. This doesn't reveal memories or perfectly hidden truths.

entries.name: Forest of False Paths
entries: In natural vegetation, forest, swamp, or jungle, the dragon leaves no trail unless it chooses, can't be tracked nonmagically, and can move through nonmagical plants without slowing. A creature tracking the dragon can be deliberately led onto a false route unless it succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Every Promise Has Teeth
entries: Once per turn, when a creature affected by one of the greatgreatwyrm's Enchantment spells, Illusion spells, Charmed effects, or Venomous Bargains damages the greatwyrm or knowingly acts directly against an instruction it accepted, that creature takes {@damage 8d10} Poison or Psychic damage (the greatgreatwyrm's choice). The creature also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: The Lie You Live By
entries: Whenever a creature fails a Saving Throw against one of the greatwyrm's Enchantment spells, Illusion spells, Charmed effects, or Venomous Bargains, it becomes Webbound for 24 hours. While both are on the same plane, the greatwyrm knows the direction and distance to a Webbound creature. A Webbound creature has Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the greatwyrm's Enchantment and Illusion spells. Once per turn, when a Webbound creature knowingly acts directly against an instruction, bargain, promise, or course of action it previously accepted from the greatwyrm, it takes {@damage 10d10} Poison or Psychic damage, chosen by the greatwyrm.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its presence carries the authority of a creature older than empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greatwyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 28, and it has +20 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes six attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The greatwyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: The greatwyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 29} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d6} Poison damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature that fails the save is also Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy applies to this Poison damage.

action.name: Sovereign Toxin
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 20} to hit, range 600 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 20d12} Poison damage. The target must make a {@dc 28} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws; can't take Reactions; and its Speed becomes 0. This attack is magical and counts as a spell attack, but isn't itself a spell. Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy applies to this damage.

legendaryHeader: The greatwyrm can take 9 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The greatwyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The greatwyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the greatwyrm passes within 25 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell of 8th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Sovereign Toxin (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Sovereign Toxin.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm rolls one additional d6 to recharge Poison Breath. If Poison Breath is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use Poison Breath.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

mythicHeader: While The Emerald Masquerade is active, the greatwyrm can use the following Mythic Actions as additional Legendary Action options. They expend Legendary Actions from the greatwyrm's normal pool.

mythic.name: False Position (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. An illusory duplicate remains where it departed until the start of its next turn. Until then, the first attack roll made against the greatwyrm has Disadvantage.

mythic.name: Whispered Certainty (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts an Enchantment or Illusion spell of 6th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending no spell slot.

mythic.name: Your Choice Was Mine (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: One Webbound creature within 300 feet must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the greatwyrm chooses whether the creature immediately uses its Reaction to move up to its Speed or make one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack against a target the greatwyrm chooses.

entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

{@b Greatwyrm Lightning Supremacy.} The greatwyrm's Lightning damage ignores Resistance and Immunity to Lightning damage. An effect that would absorb, redirect, convert, or turn the greatwyrm's Lightning damage into healing can't do so. The damage is dealt normally instead. Effects that reduce damage without depending on its damage type function normally.
{@b Perfect High Magic Recovery.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic. This can restore an expended use of a 9th-level spell.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell in the Blue Dragon Spell List through 9th-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 36 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell chain lightning|XPHB}, {@spell reverse gravity|XPHB}, {@spell control weather|XPHB}, {@spell time stop|XPHB}, {@spell meteor swarm|XPHB}, {@spell power word kill|XPHB}, and {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic requires Material components only if costly or consumed.

trait.name: The Living Tempest (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges its Lightning Breath; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, a supernatural storm extends 500 feet from the greatwyrm and moves with it.

At the start of each hostile creature's turn in the storm, the greatwyrm can cause lightning to strike that creature for {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage. Greatwyrm Lightning Supremacy applies to this damage. Hostile flying creatures can't gain altitude within the storm. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, its Lightning Breath automatically recharges. While The Living Tempest is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Throne of the Storm
entries: Blue dragons regard the sky as a throne and the horizon as the boundary of their court. Mirage, thunder, sand, and lightning blur together around their territories. Eventually the weather ceases to be something surrounding the dragon and becomes something obeying it.

entries.name: Mirage of the Wastes
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 hour. The dragon creates a harmless visual or auditory mirage within 60 feet occupying no more than a 10-foot Cube. Physical interaction reveals that it isn't real. The dragon also ignores natural penalties caused by extreme heat and blowing sand.

entries.name: Static Step
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When the dragon is targeted by an attack, it can move up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If this movement changes whether the attack can legally reach it, the attack is resolved using the dragon's new position. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Storm Dominion
entries: The dragon emits a 60-foot aura. Hostile creatures treat flying movement in the aura as Difficult Terrain. Hostile creatures also have Disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks made through more than 20 feet of the aura. The dragon chooses whether the effect visibly manifests as wind, sand, static, or clear storm pressure.

entries.name: Thunder Answers Defiance
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet casts a spell or takes a Reaction, the dragon can strike it with lightning. The creature makes a Dexterity Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC, taking {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

entries.name: The Sky Belongs to Me
entries: The greatwyrm emits a 300-foot aura. At the start of a hostile flying creature's turn in the aura, that creature must make a Strength Saving Throw against the greatgreatwyrm's Spell Save DC. On a failure, the greatwyrm can force that creature downward by up to 120 feet. once per turn when the greatwyrm deals Lightning damage, it can arc lightning to another creature within 60 feet of the original target. That second creature makes a Dexterity Saving Throw against the greatgreatwyrm's Spell Save DC, taking {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

entries.name: There Is No Sky but Mine
entries: The greatwyrm emits a 500-foot aura. Hostile creatures in the aura treat flying movement as Difficult Terrain and can't willingly ascend above the greatwyrm. At the start of a hostile flying creature's turn in the aura, it must make a {@dc 29} Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the greatwyrm forces it downward by up to 180 feet. Once per turn when the greatwyrm deals Lightning damage to a creature, it can arc lightning to up to three other creatures within 60 feet of the original target. Each secondary target must make a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw, taking {@damage 8d10} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: To a red dragon, possession is not a legal concept but a fact of nature. What it claims becomes part of its identity, and resistance to its authority is treated as a personal insult. With age, the distinction between its treasure, its territory, and the world it believes it deserves begins to disappear.

entries.name: Claimed Treasure
entries: The greatwyrm must touch the object for 1 minute to use this feature. The claim lasts until the dragon willingly releases it. The dragon can mystically mark up to PB × 10 objects as Claimed Treasure. While a Claimed object is on the same plane and within 1 mile, the dragon knows its direction, approximate distance, and whether it is moving. entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The greatwyrm creates a 300-foot aura. At the start of each hostile creature's turn in the aura, that creature must make a Charisma Saving Throw against the greatgreatwyrm's Spell Save DC. On a failed save, until the start of its next turn the creature can't teleport, can't become Invisible, can't willingly move farther from the greatwyrm, and can't carry a Claimed Treasure farther away from it.

entries.name: The World Is Mine
entries: Whenever All Beneath the Crown is active, its radius becomes 500 feet. Every unattended object and structure in the aura is considered Claimed Treasure for the purpose of the greatwyrm's features. A hostile creature that fails the Saving Throw against All Beneath the Crown can't teleport, become Invisible, willingly move farther from the greatwyrm, or remove a Claimed object farther from it. In addition, the first time each turn such a creature damages the greatwyrm or attempts to take, destroy, move, or magically alter something the greatwyrm has Claimed, it takes {@damage 10d10} Fire damage.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its presence carries the authority of a creature older than empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 30} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greatwyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 30, and it has +22 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes six attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The greatwyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: The greatwyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d6} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature that fails the save also burns until the end of its next turn, taking {@damage 6d10} Fire damage at the start of its turn. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this Fire damage.

action.name: Worldfire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 22} to hit, range 800 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 20d12} Fire damage. On a hit, each creature other than the target within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw, taking {@damage 8d10} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. This attack is magical and counts as a spell attack, but isn't itself a spell. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage.

legendaryHeader: The greatwyrm can take 9 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The greatwyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The greatwyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the greatwyrm passes within 25 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell of 8th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Worldfire (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Worldfire.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm rolls one additional d6 to recharge Fire Breath. If Fire Breath is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use Fire Breath.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

mythicHeader: While The Burning Crown is active, the greatwyrm can use the following Mythic Actions as additional Legendary Action options. They expend Legendary Actions from the greatwyrm's normal pool.

mythic.name: Imperial Reprisal (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses one creature within 300 feet that damaged it since the end of its previous turn. That creature takes {@damage 8d10} Fire damage. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage.

mythic.name: Kneel (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each hostile creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 120 feet must make a {@dc 30} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0, and it can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

mythic.name: Burn the Rebellious (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm immediately uses Fire Breath. Creatures currently affected by All Beneath the Crown make the Saving Throw against this use with Disadvantage.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Young Mind, Ancient Blood.} The dragon is fully sapient but still a child. It can speak, reason, learn, negotiate, deceive, understand consequences, and make simple plans. It lacks older dragons' experience and restraint; sapience alone grants no scholarly, strategic, or spellcasting expertise.

{@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.
{@b No Change Shape.} This wyrmling doesn't possess Change Shape. Metallic dragons of this lineage begin developing Change Shape at the Young age category.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Fire, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 3. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows the listed Brass Dragon spells through 1-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast its Innate Draconic Spellcasting At Will spells without spell slots or usage limits. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell speak with animals|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each spell listed under Draconic High Magic once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic: {@spell sleep|XPHB}.

trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. The dragon similarly understands the general meaning of spoken language it hears, though this doesn't decipher codes, secret meanings, or magically concealed information.

entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Growing Draconic Mind.} The dragon is no longer merely a gifted child. Experience has begun turning instinct into judgment, curiosity into expertise, and power into deliberate technique. It can now pursue plans that last months or years rather than moments. A Young Metallic Dragon can plan ahead, study magic, make agreements, manage territory, and understand social structures far better than a wyrmling, though it still lacks the accumulated experience of an Adult Dragon.

{@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. Its growing experience makes it more reliable than a wyrmling, but this trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 9 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Draconic Magical Instinct; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the form's physical characteristics: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

entries.name: Shelter in the Storm
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The Temporary Hit Points last until depleted or replaced; condition removal is instantaneous. The dragon chooses a creature within 60 feet. entries.name: Merciful Intercession
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points, the dragon can cause it to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. The dragon can then move that creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dragon can see. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against all spells and other magical effects. Spellward Scales supersedes Argent Ward while the dragon is at the Young age category or older.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its presence commands the fear earned by centuries of survival. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic requires Material components only if costly or consumed.

trait.name: The World Plays Along
entries: Copper dragons rarely accept the world exactly as they find it. Stone becomes a stage, distance becomes a joke, and certainty becomes something to be mocked. With age, reality itself seems increasingly willing to participate in the dragon's tricks.

entries.name: Mischievous Ground
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 10-foot square of ground within 60 feet and magically alters its texture and shape. It can make the area Difficult Terrain, harmlessly slippery, uneven enough to grant Half Cover to a Small creature, or visually appear slightly different. The alteration isn't permanent.

entries.name: Wrong Step
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet moves at least 10 feet, the dragon can distort the ground beneath it. The creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, the dragon moves it up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space on the same surface, and it falls Prone.

entries.name: Laughing Terrain
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 60-foot-radius area within 120 feet and can continuously reshape nonmagical earth and stone there into slopes, shallow pits, waist-high walls, ramps, steps, pillars, or trenches. No single alteration can directly crush a creature or instantly destroy a building. The dragon can rearrange the affected terrain again as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Impossible Shortcut
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon enters a solid earth or stone surface and emerges from another connected earth or stone surface within 300 feet. Creatures and objects it is carrying travel with it. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks and doesn't require line of sight, provided the two surfaces are connected by earth or stone.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its presence commands the fear earned by centuries of survival. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 180 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 22, and it has +14 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed. When the dragon casts {@spell chromatic orb|XPHB} through this trait, it can choose only Acid as the spell's damage type.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes four attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The dragon can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d10 + 8} Piercing damage plus {@damage 6d8} Acid damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d6 + 8} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d8 + 8} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d6 + 8} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales its breath weapon in a 120-foot-long, 15-foot-wide Line. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 24d8} Acid damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Ancient Acid Supremacy applies to this Acid damage.

action.name: Slowing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon exhales slowing gas in a 90-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, its Speed is halved, it can't take Reactions, it can make only one attack during its turn, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 5 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The dragon casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of the dragon must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6 + 8} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon chooses one of its Breath Weapons and rolls one additional d6 to recharge that Breath Weapon. If the chosen Breath Weapon is already available, the dragon can instead immediately use that Breath Weapon.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon casts one spell of 5th level or lower that normally has a casting time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The dragon casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

monster.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon

conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 23 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Draconic Magical Instinct; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the form's physical characteristics: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Lightning, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Ancient Lightning Supremacy.} The dragon's Lightning damage ignores Lightning Resistance. When the dragon deals Lightning damage to a creature with Lightning Immunity, that Immunity is treated as Lightning Resistance, and the dragon then ignores that Resistance. As a result, the dragon's Lightning damage affects creatures with Lightning Resistance or Lightning Immunity without reducing the damage.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 14. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.
{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows the Bronze Dragon spells presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait through 9th-level magic.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast its Innate Draconic Spellcasting At Will spells without spell slots or usage limits. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell protection from evil and good|XPHB}, {@spell see invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell shatter|XPHB}, {@spell lightning bolt|XPHB}, {@spell protection from energy|XPHB}, {@spell control winds|XGE}, {@spell chain lightning|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell chain lightning|XPHB}, {@spell control weather|XPHB}, {@spell reverse gravity|XPHB}, {@spell storm of vengeance|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic requires Material components only if costly or consumed.

trait.name: Stormwarden's Instinct
entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

entries.name: Protective Instinct
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the dragon can impose a penalty equal to its PB on the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Storm Interception
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet is targeted by an attack, the dragon can move up to half its Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If physically possible, the dragon places itself between the attacker and target and becomes the target of the attack instead. If the attack hits the dragon, the attacker takes Lightning damage equal to PB × 1d8.

entries.name: Guardian of the Storm
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet fails a Saving Throw against a spell or magical effect, the dragon can allow it to reroll the Saving Throw. If the reroll succeeds, lightning strikes the source of the effect, dealing {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage to it.

entries.name: Storm Answers Harm
entries: This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn. Whenever a creature within 120 feet damages one of the dragon's chosen allies, that attacker becomes Storm-Marked until the end of the dragon's next turn. The first time the dragon damages that creature while it is Storm-Marked, it takes an additional {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage, can't take Reactions, and has its Speed halved until the end of the dragon's next turn.

trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

entries.name: Shelter in the Storm
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The Temporary Hit Points last until depleted or replaced; condition removal is instantaneous. The dragon chooses a creature within 60 feet. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the dragon's PB + its Charisma modifier. The creature can immediately end either the Frightened or Charmed condition on itself.

entries.name: Merciful Intercession
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points, the dragon can cause it to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. The dragon can then move that creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dragon can see. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon creates a 120-foot aura. Chosen creatures in the aura have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, can't have their Hit Point maximum reduced, can't be prevented from regaining Hit Points, and can't be instantly killed while above 0 Hit Points.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against all spells and other magical effects. Spellward Scales supersedes Argent Ward while the dragon is at the Young age category or older.

entries.name: Unbroken Silver Aegis
entries: Magic bends around the elder silver dragon rather than finding easy purchase. Force that should imprison it fractures against its scales. Attempts to banish, bind, or displace it meet a will reinforced by living arcane armor. The dragon retains Magic Resistance and is Immune to Force damage. It has Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist forced teleportation, banishment, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement. When a magical effect would teleport or banish the dragon against its will, the dragon can use its Reaction to cause that effect to fail against it.

An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell heal|XPHB}, {@spell resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell true resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell holy aura|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic requires Material components only if costly or consumed.

trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. This doesn't automatically reveal an Invisible creature, but it visibly marks the space occupied by a target that was actually hit.

entries.name: Radiant Authority
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. That creature becomes Judged. Once per turn, when the Judged creature damages another creature, willingly breaks a promise it made to the dragon during this duration, or attempts to harm a creature the dragon explicitly placed under its protection, the dragon can deal {@damage 2d8} + its Charisma modifier Radiant damage to the Judged creature without using an Action. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must actually know or observe the triggering conduct.

entries.name: Sovereign Presence
entries: Chosen allies within 60 feet gain a bonus equal to the dragon's PB to Saving Throws against Charmed and Frightened, have Resistance to Radiant damage, and have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura while Judged takes Radiant damage equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier + PB.

entries.name: Judgment of the Sun
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 180 feet. The target must make a {@dc 25} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is Condemned for 1 minute. While Condemned, it can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the dragon; Fire or Radiant Immunity is treated as Resistance against the dragon; it can't become Invisible to the dragon; and whenever it damages another creature, it takes {@damage 4d10} Radiant damage. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its presence commands the fear earned by centuries of survival. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 180 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d10 + 10} Piercing damage plus {@damage 6d8} Fire damage.

action.name: Weakening Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon exhales weakening gas in a 90-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Strength Saving Throw. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the wyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The wyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 26 or lower, or returns to its true form.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. entries.name: Words Before Violence
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. This effect lasts until the start of the triggering creature's next turn. When a creature within 60 feet that can hear the dragon makes an Attack Roll, the dragon can speak a warning, argument, insult, plea, or distraction. The creature makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on that attack, can't make Opportunity Attacks, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Command the Conversation
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Creatures of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, a creature can't willingly attack the dragon or a creature designated by the dragon until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. entries.name: Voice Across Kingdoms

This isn't telepathy and doesn't allow a recipient to answer the dragon automatically.

entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The wyrm creates a 500-foot aura of enforced parley. On a failed save, the attempted hostile act expends neither the creature's Action, spell slot, nor limited use, but the creature can't attempt that hostile act again until the start of its next turn. This effect isn't Charmed and functions against creatures immune to Charmed.

entries: Copper dragons rarely accept the world exactly as they find it. Stone becomes a stage, distance becomes a joke, and certainty becomes something to be mocked. With age, reality itself seems increasingly willing to participate in the dragon's tricks.

entries.name: Mischievous Ground
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 10-foot square of ground within 60 feet and magically alters its texture and shape. trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the wyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The wyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 29 or lower, or returns to its true form.

entries: When the wyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. trait.name: Stormwarden's Instinct
entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

entries.name: Protective Instinct
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the dragon can impose a penalty equal to its PB on the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Storm Interception
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet is targeted by an attack, the dragon can move up to half its Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If physically possible, the dragon places itself between the attacker and target and becomes the target of the attack instead. If the attack hits the dragon, the attacker takes Lightning damage equal to PB × 1d8.

entries.name: Guardian of the Storm
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet fails a Saving Throw against a spell or magical effect, the dragon can allow it to reroll the Saving Throw. If the reroll succeeds, lightning strikes the source of the effect, dealing {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage to it.

entries.name: Storm Answers Harm
entries: This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn. Whenever a creature within 120 feet damages one of the dragon's chosen allies, that attacker becomes Storm-Marked until the end of the dragon's next turn. The first time the dragon damages that creature while it is Storm-Marked, it takes an additional {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage, can't take Reactions, and has its Speed halved until the end of the dragon's next turn.

entries.name: No One Falls While I Stand
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature the wyrm can see within 300 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, the wyrm can move up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If it ends this movement within 30 feet of that creature, the creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and gains 58 Temporary Hit Points. The source that dealt the triggering damage is then struck by lightning and takes {@damage 10d10} Lightning damage. This feature doesn't require the wyrm to cast a spell.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its presence commands the fear earned by centuries of survival. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. a creature that fails its initial Saving Throw can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. This additional effect occurs only on the initial failed save.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

This Force movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

Instead, it regains Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges both of its Breath Weapons; regains 3 expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic, including a 9th-level spell; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions.

trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. This doesn't automatically reveal an Invisible creature, but it visibly marks the space occupied by a target that was actually hit.

entries.name: Radiant Authority
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. That creature becomes Judged. Once per turn, when the Judged creature damages another creature, willingly breaks a promise it made to the dragon during this duration, or attempts to harm a creature the dragon explicitly placed under its protection, the dragon can deal {@damage 2d8} + its Charisma modifier Radiant damage to the Judged creature without using an Action. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must actually know or observe the triggering conduct.

entries.name: Sovereign Presence
entries: Chosen allies within 60 feet gain a bonus equal to the dragon's PB to Saving Throws against Charmed and Frightened, have Resistance to Radiant damage, and have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura while Judged takes Radiant damage equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier + PB.

entries.name: Judgment of the Sun
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 180 feet. The target must make a {@dc 25} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is Condemned for 1 minute. While Condemned, it can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the dragon; Fire or Radiant Immunity is treated as Resistance against the dragon; it can't become Invisible to the dragon; and whenever it damages another creature, it takes {@damage 4d10} Radiant damage. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The wyrm emits sunlight in a 300-foot radius. Chosen allies in the sunlight have Resistance to all damage from spells, regain 20 Hit Points at the start of each of their turns, and can't be Charmed or Frightened. Hostile creatures in the sunlight can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the wyrm. Fire and Radiant Immunity are treated as Resistance against the wyrm, and hostile creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the wyrm's Fire or Radiant effects. When the wyrm uses its Fire Breath, it can convert any portion of that damage to Radiant damage.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its presence commands the fear earned by centuries of survival. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. a creature that fails its initial Saving Throw can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. This additional effect occurs only on the initial failed save.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 27, and it has +19 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyrm makes five attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The wyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 20} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 8d8} Fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 20} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 20} to hit, reach 35 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 20} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: The wyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 28} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 36d6} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Wyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage.

action.name: Weakening Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The wyrm exhales weakening gas in a 120-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 28} Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength Saving Throws, its Strength-based weapon attacks deal half damage, and its carrying, lifting, and pushing capacity is halved. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryHeader: The wyrm can take 7 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The wyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The wyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The wyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The wyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The wyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 25 feet of the wyrm must make a {@dc 28} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The wyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The wyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the wyrm passes within 20 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 28} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The wyrm casts one spell of 7th level or lower that normally has a casting time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The wyrm chooses one of its Breath Weapons and rolls one additional d6 to recharge that Breath Weapon. If the chosen Breath Weapon is already available, the wyrm can instead immediately use that Breath Weapon.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The wyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

monster.name: Brass Greatwyrm

conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (9/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Greatwyrm Magic Resistance.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects. Spell attack rolls against the greatwyrm are made with Disadvantage.
{@b Perfect Concentration.} The greatwyrm automatically succeeds on Constitution Saving Throws made to maintain Concentration as a result of taking damage.
{@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the greatwyrm casts a spell whose primary damage type is Fire, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy.} The greatwyrm's Fire damage ignores Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage. An effect that would absorb, redirect, convert, or turn the greatwyrm's Fire damage into healing can't do so. The damage is dealt normally instead. Effects that reduce damage without depending on its damage type function normally.
{@b Perfect High Magic Recovery.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic. This can restore an expended use of a 9th-level spell.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell presented in its Brass Dragon spell list through 9th-level magic, as shown in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The greatwyrm can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The greatwyrm can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the greatwyrm's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell speak with animals|XPHB}, {@spell calm emotions|XPHB}, {@spell suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell sending|XPHB}, {@spell tongues|XPHB}, {@spell charm monster|XGE}, {@spell mass suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell project image|XPHB}, {@spell teleport|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The greatwyrm is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 34 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell dream|XPHB}, {@spell mass suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell teleport|XPHB}, {@spell mirage arcane|XPHB}, {@spell project image|XPHB}, {@spell power word stun|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}, {@spell foresight|XPHB}, and {@spell power word heal|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. Draconic High Magic requires Material components only if costly or consumed.

trait.name: The Final Parley (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges both of its Breath Weapons; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, the greatwyrm radiates an aura of absolute discourse extending 1,000 feet from it and moving with it.

Hostile creatures in the aura can't take Reactions. The World Must Hear is active throughout this duration without requiring an Action. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, both of its Breath Weapons automatically recharge. While The Final Parley is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. The dragon similarly understands the general meaning of spoken language it hears, though this doesn't decipher codes, secret meanings, or magically concealed information.

entries.name: Words Before Violence
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. This effect lasts until the start of the triggering creature's next turn. When a creature within 60 feet that can hear the dragon makes an Attack Roll, the dragon can speak a warning, argument, insult, plea, or distraction. The creature makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on that attack, can't make Opportunity Attacks, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Command the Conversation
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Creatures of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, a creature can't willingly attack the dragon or a creature designated by the dragon until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Taking damage from a protected creature immediately allows another save. This effect isn't Charmed and functions against creatures immune to Charmed.

entries.name: Voice Across Kingdoms
entries: The dragon can deliberately project its voice to any location within 10 miles that it knows. Its speech arrives clearly at the chosen location regardless of intervening terrain. The dragon can choose to speak simultaneously through any number of points within that radius and can choose which creatures at those points hear it. This isn't telepathy and doesn't allow a recipient to answer the dragon automatically.

entries.name: The World Must Hear
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The greatwyrm creates a 500-foot aura of enforced parley. Before a hostile creature in the aura that can hear the greatwyrm can make an attack, cast a damaging spell, or use an effect that forces another creature to make a Saving Throw to deal damage, it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the greatwyrm's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the attempted hostile act expends neither the creature's Action, spell slot, nor limited use, but the creature can't attempt that hostile act again until the start of its next turn. This effect isn't Charmed and functions against creatures immune to Charmed.

entries.name: The Last Word
entries: When the greatwyrm uses The World Must Hear, the aura's radius becomes 1,000 feet. Every creature in the aura that knows at least one language can understand the greatwyrm while it speaks, regardless of the language used. A hostile creature must make the Saving Throw required by The World Must Hear before each hostile act covered by that feature. When a hostile creature succeeds on that Saving Throw, the greatwyrm can force it to reroll the Saving Throw and use the lower result.
The greatwyrm can do so once on each creature's turn without using a Reaction. A creature that fails can't attempt another hostile act covered by The World Must Hear until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its presence carries the authority of a creature older than empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

mythicHeader: While The Final Parley is active, the greatwyrm can use the following Mythic Actions as additional Legendary Action options. They expend Legendary Actions from the greatwyrm's normal pool.

mythic.name: Voice Above Violence (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 300 feet that can hear the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, it can't make Opportunity Attacks, and Attack Rolls it makes before the end of its next turn have Disadvantage.

mythic.name: All Will Hear (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses up to three creatures within 300 feet that can hear it. Each chosen creature must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, that creature can't take hostile Actions or Bonus Actions until the end of its next turn.

entries: Each hostile creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 120 feet that can hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn, the creature can't take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions that would damage another creature or force another creature to make a Saving Throw against a damaging effect. This effect isn't Charmed.
