monsterFluff.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A red dragon wyrmling resembles a small furnace, with broad jaws, bright scales, and heat shimmering around its teeth. It bargains, boasts, threatens, and remembers insults, but pride still outpaces its judgment.
It fiercely guards anything it claims. Its first magic feels instinctive and commanding rather than learned.

monsterFluff.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
entries: Lean and dark-scaled, a black dragon wyrmling hides among stagnant water and ruins. Its patience already favors ambush, while its immature cruelty tests what frightens others. Acid, mud, concealment, and decay are instinctive tools.

monsterFluff.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A blue dragon wyrmling is athletic, horned, and proud. It experiments with bluffing and misdirection, shaping encounters through sand, static, and mirages before loosing lightning.

monsterFluff.name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A green dragon wyrmling watches faces as closely as weapons. Slender and leaf-scaled, it tests imitation, bargains, poison, and illusion to discover others' desires while concealing its own.

monsterFluff.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A white dragon wyrmling is pale and heavily built for pursuit across ice. Fully sapient but inexperienced, it relies on observation and instinct, keenly noticing tracks, scents, wounds, and changes in its hunting grounds.

monsterFluff.name: Young Red Dragon
entries: A young red dragon has grown into a powerful aerial predator whose scarlet scales darken around the horns, chest, and wing joints like metal repeatedly heated in a forge. Its confidence is no longer merely childish bravado. It has begun learning how fear, intimidation, physical dominance, and carefully chosen displays of strength can make others yield without a full fight.

Its magic now reinforces that tyranny: flames answer more readily, its claimed possessions matter more deeply, and confronting it often feels like challenging a ruler who has already decided the outcome.

monsterFluff.name: Young Black Dragon
entries: A young black dragon moves through swamps and ruins with unnerving efficiency, its narrow silhouette and hooked horns appearing only when it decides concealment has stopped being useful. It has learned that an ambush can be more satisfying and more effective than a frontal attack. Survival, stealth, and deception now form part of the same predatory logic. Its acid is becoming more than a breath weapon: it is a means of ruining defenses, spoiling recovery, and turning a single successful surprise into a prolonged collapse.

monsterFluff.name: Young Blue Dragon
entries: A young blue dragon is a swift and disciplined hunter, its wings built for long, controlled flight and its horned profile unmistakable against a storm-lit horizon. It has begun combining deception with practical survival instincts, using distance, visibility, terrain, and timing to dictate how an encounter develops. Lightning is only one part of its growing control. Sudden movement, charged air, mirages, and carefully chosen positions allow it to fight as though the battlefield were already mapped in its mind.

monsterFluff.name: Young Green Dragon
entries: A young green dragon is graceful rather than bulky, able to disappear among foliage and shadow before reappearing exactly where a conversation becomes uncomfortable. It has learned that promises, fear, secrecy, and desire can be more useful than brute strength. Deception and stealth now support one another naturally. Its magic increasingly turns words into leverage. Agreements can become dangerous, illusions become more convincing, and poison becomes only one of several ways it punishes misplaced trust.

monsterFluff.name: Young White Dragon
entries: A young white dragon is a powerful pursuit predator, its pale scales blending into snowfields while broad wings and heavy limbs let it attack from almost any direction. Experience has begun turning instinct into technique. It knows how to stalk, hide, follow, close distance, and use terrain rather than merely charging the nearest target. Once it chooses prey, escape becomes increasingly difficult. Snow, ice, and cold support its pursuit instead of slowing it.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Red Dragon
entries: An adult red dragon is a colossal engine of muscle, armor, and heat, every motion carrying the weight of a creature accustomed to being the most dangerous thing in sight. Centuries of victories and failures have sharpened its arrogance into something more disciplined. It can read hesitation, exploit weakness, and use history and reputation as weapons alongside fang and flame.

Around it, fire becomes an expression of dominion rather than simple destruction. Its spells, breath, and supernatural authority all reinforce the same message: resistance is not merely opposition, but defiance.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Black Dragon
entries: An adult black dragon seems designed for places where civilizations have failed. Its scarred scales, skeletal profile, and corrosive breath make it look perfectly at home among drowned temples and broken fortresses. Its intelligence is expressed through patience, cruelty, and a careful understanding of when structures—physical or social—are close to breaking. Destruction feeds its momentum. The fall of an enemy, the collapse of a wall, or the failure of a plan can all become opportunities it immediately turns into further advantage.

monsterFluff.name: Adult White Dragon
entries: An adult white dragon is massive, scarred, and built for violent acceleration, with a physicality that makes every landing, bite, and wingbeat feel like an avalanche beginning. It may not cultivate elaborate social games, but centuries of hunting have taught it pattern recognition, endurance, ambush, and the practical reading of an opponent's movement. It learns from prey during the fight itself, adapting to repeated attacks and methods with the brutal efficiency of a predator that survives by remembering what hurt.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Green Dragon
entries: An adult green dragon has the poise of a courtier and the physical presence of an apex predator, a combination that makes its politeness more dangerous rather than less. It reads motives, remembers loyalties, studies inconsistencies, and can spend a conversation quietly deciding which fear or desire is most useful. Its enchantments, illusions, and poisonous power blur together into a single method of control. Fighting it often begins long after the first mistake has already been made.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Blue Dragon
entries: An adult blue dragon carries itself with military precision. Its heavy scales, enormous wings, and crackling electrical aura give the impression of a siege weapon that learned strategy. Its confidence is reinforced by experience: it studies behavior, notices patterns, and understands when to intimidate, deceive, retreat, or force an opponent into a bad angle. The air around it becomes hostile to careless movement and distant attacks. Wind, thunder, lightning, and illusion all serve a single purpose—control of space.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Red Dragon
entries: An ancient red dragon looks less like a beast and more like a living catastrophe crowned in horn and ember, its scales scarred by ages of battle without diminishing their majesty. It has had centuries to study kingdoms, wars, adventurers, rival dragons, and every other kind of challenger foolish enough to approach it. Its rage remains immense, but it is now backed by experience and calculation. Its fire no longer respects ordinary defenses, and its mastery of magic makes the old distinction between dragon and archmage feel increasingly meaningless.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient White Dragon
entries: An ancient white dragon is a living apex of cold-weather predation, its huge pale form able to vanish into storm and ice with a grace that seems impossible at its scale. Its memory for hunts has become a library of movement, scent, fear, terrain, endurance, and failed escapes. Against chosen prey, invisibility, fog, snow, and ordinary mobility provide little comfort. Cold becomes a means not only of injury, but of ending movement entirely.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Black Dragon
entries: An ancient black dragon carries the atmosphere of a ruin before anything around it has actually fallen. Its presence makes armor, stone, courage, and even hope seem temporary. It has spent centuries learning how creatures survive, lie, hide, fortify themselves, and recover. That knowledge is used not to build, but to dismantle with precision. Its acid attacks healing, regeneration, objects, and structures as readily as flesh. To face it is to discover how many things one assumed would endure were never truly permanent.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Green Dragon
entries: An ancient green dragon appears almost inseparable from old forests and overgrown ruins, moving through vegetation with a silence that seems impossible for something so large. Its experience with deception is no longer limited to lies. It understands politics, behavior, survival, persuasion, investigation, and the dangerous difference between what someone says and what they are trying to protect.
Tracks vanish, paths become unreliable, and magical influence surrounds every negotiation. Those who deal with it may leave uncertain whether they escaped a trap or merely entered a larger one.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Blue Dragon
entries: An ancient blue dragon seems less to fly through storms than to occupy their center. Lightning crawls across its scales while wind and pressure change around its slightest movement. Centuries of conflict have turned its deceptions into calculated doctrine. It can read enemies, investigate unfamiliar magic, and exploit mistakes before most opponents realize they have made them. Its lightning ignores protections that would stop lesser dragons, and magic cast nearby can itself become an invitation for immediate retaliation.

monsterFluff.name: White Wyrm
entries: A white wyrm is the idea of pursuit given titanic form, vast enough to cross enormous distances while still retaining the focus of a predator following a single trail. Its intellect is expressed through accumulated survival knowledge rather than courtly polish: weather, geography, movement, scent, weakness, endurance, and the behavior of fleeing creatures. Once it marks a quarry, magical escape becomes only another stage of the chase. Distance matters, but not nearly as much as the prey hopes.

monsterFluff.name: Black Wyrm
entries: A black wyrm resembles the final stage of decay made animate, vast enough that its silhouette can turn marshland, drowned cities, or battlefields into a single hunting ground. It possesses the patience of geological time and the malice of something that has watched countless proud things become debris. Its corrosive power no longer merely wounds. It erodes barriers, armor, healing, fortifications, and magical protections with the same merciless certainty, as though permanence itself were an error it intends to correct.

monsterFluff.name: Green Wyrm
entries: A green wyrm is an immense, elegant presence whose voice can be more threatening than its claws because every word sounds chosen for a reason. It has accumulated ages of secrets, bargains, social patterns, betrayals, and observed weaknesses, giving it an almost terrifying fluency in intelligent behavior. Promises, enchantments, illusions, poison, and manipulation become parts of the same supernatural web. Opposition to it is dangerous not only because it is powerful, but because it is very good at ensuring others help create their own consequences.

monsterFluff.name: Blue Wyrm
entries: A blue wyrm dominates the sky by presence alone, immense wings spanning distances that make ordinary aerial combat seem trivial. Its mind is that of a strategist who has spent ages studying weather, warfare, psychology, architecture, travel, and the countless ways creatures try to gain positional advantage. Around it, the sky ceases to be neutral territory. Flight, storms, lightning, and long-range movement all exist on terms the wyrm increasingly dictates.

monsterFluff.name: Red Wyrm
entries: A red wyrm is tyranny given a body: mountain-sized, furnace-bright beneath the scales, and so physically imposing that lesser creatures can mistake its stillness for part of the landscape. Its mind carries ages of conquest, humiliation, victory, negotiation, and rule. It can threaten like a warlord, reason like a monarch, and speak with the certainty of something that has outlived entire political orders.

Its flame, magic, and will have become one continuous act of sovereignty. When it declares something claimed, threatened, or condemned, the declaration feels less like an opinion and more like a law the world is expected to obey.

monsterFluff.name: White Greatwyrm
entries: A white greatwyrm is the final expression of the endless hunt, an immense pale predator whose presence turns entire landscapes into extensions of its pursuit. It has survived so long that scent, tracks, weather, movement, magic, and remembered behavior form a single continuous map in its mind. When it chooses prey, distance, invisibility, teleportation, and even planar travel cease to be reliable forms of escape.

monsterFluff.name: Black Greatwyrm
entries: A black greatwyrm seems less like a living creature than the certainty of collapse given scales, wings, and intention. Its acid attacks flesh, stone, steel, fortification, and magical protection with the same merciless logic: everything built can be dismantled. Around it, repair becomes temporary, defenses begin to fail, and even powerful magic can feel like another structure waiting to rot.

monsterFluff.name: Green Greatwyrm
entries: A green greatwyrm has spent ages learning that control rarely requires force when desire, fear, trust, and certainty can be shaped instead. Its lies are not random falsehoods but carefully constructed environments in which every bargain, secret, illusion, and promise reinforces another. Those caught in its influence may understand that they are being manipulated and still discover that every apparent escape was anticipated.

monsterFluff.name: Blue Greatwyrm
entries: A blue greatwyrm treats the open sky as sovereign territory and every storm within sight as a potential instrument of war. Centuries of strategy have taught it to think in altitude, distance, pressure, line of fire, movement, and timing with terrifying precision. When it enters battle, flying creatures discover that the sky itself now has an owner.

monsterFluff.name: Red Greatwyrm
entries: A red greatwyrm is sovereignty made physical, a living catastrophe that has survived long enough to mistake continued victory for proof of natural authority. Its hoard, territory, flame, magic, and identity have become inseparable expressions of possession. In its presence, resistance is treated not merely as opposition but as rebellion against a world the greatwyrm already considers its own.

monsterFluff.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A brass dragon wyrmling is bright-eyed, long-faced, and quick to react to voices, movement, and anything that looks like the beginning of a story. It is sociable and curious but still unmistakably young, capable of earnest questions, playful arguments, and impulsive conclusions without the restraint of an elder. Language comes almost unnaturally easily to it. Even before its magic matures, communication feels less like a learned skill and more like part of its draconic nature.

monsterFluff.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A copper dragon wyrmling is compact, expressive, and constantly interested in surfaces, objects, reactions, and the consequences of small changes. It enjoys tricks and misdirection but lacks the polish of an older dragon; many of its jokes are experiments in discovering what makes other creatures surprised, irritated, or amused. Earth and stone already seem unusually cooperative around it, shifting just enough to turn terrain into part of the joke.

monsterFluff.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A bronze dragon wyrmling is sturdy, alert, and unusually quick to notice when another creature is in danger. It is still young and can misjudge situations, but its first instinct is often to move toward a threat rather than away from it. Lightning gathers around those protective impulses. Even a simple attempt to interfere with an attack can bring a sharp electrical answer.

monsterFluff.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A silver dragon wyrmling has pale, reflective scales and a calm, watchful expression, with cold mist often gathering around its breath even when it is not attacking. It is thoughtful for its age but still inexperienced, relying on curiosity, empathy, and instinct rather than centuries of judgment. Its first magical defenses already show a distinctive character: hostile magic seems to catch against an invisible pressure around its scales instead of reaching it cleanly.

monsterFluff.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A gold dragon wyrmling is bright-scaled, broad-faced, and visibly radiant when excited or angered, with firelight often shading toward something cleaner and more luminous. It is intelligent and earnest but still a child, capable of strong convictions before it has enough experience to understand every consequence. Its fire already carries the possibility of radiant transformation, hinting that its magic is as much about judgment and protection as heat.

monsterFluff.name: Young Brass Dragon
entries: A young brass dragon is lean, quick, and animated, often using posture, wings, and expression as actively as its voice. It has learned that conversation can redirect danger, reveal motives, and control the rhythm of a conflict without ever becoming mind control. Its magic reinforces that instinct. Words can distract, warn, soothe, manipulate attention, and occasionally accomplish what claws would only make harder.

monsterFluff.name: Young Copper Dragon
entries: A young copper dragon is agile, sharp-eyed, and difficult to predict, especially in broken ground where a single misplaced step can ruin an opponent's plan. It has begun combining deception, performance, and practical observation into a style that makes it hard to tell when it is joking and when it has already arranged an advantage. Its magic turns movement into uncertainty. Ground, distance, positioning, and illusion all become opportunities for a trick with tactical consequences.

monsterFluff.name: Young Bronze Dragon
entries: A young bronze dragon is powerfully built and highly mobile, comfortable in air, water, and the chaotic spaces where allies and enemies collide. It has begun developing the awareness needed to protect others deliberately, reading attacks, movement, and threats instead of merely reacting on instinct. Its storm magic turns defense into retaliation. To attack someone under its protection is often to invite the dragon itself into the line of fire.

monsterFluff.name: Young Silver Dragon
entries: A young silver dragon is graceful and composed, its metallic scales reflecting light in a way that makes the edges of its body seem almost unnaturally sharp and clear. It has begun combining social awareness with deep magical intuition, reading both people and spells before deciding how to respond. Its defenses have matured into true spell resistance. Cold remains part of its nature, but Force, wards, restoration, and protection increasingly define the way it uses magic.

monsterFluff.name: Young Gold Dragon
entries: A young gold dragon has grown into a commanding but graceful figure, its scales carrying the color of heated metal at dawn. It has begun learning the difficult difference between authority and mere force, using insight, persuasion, and judgment alongside physical power. Its magic can mark those it considers dangerous, answer harmful behavior with radiant punishment, and turn ordinary flame into something closer to sunlight.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Brass Dragon
entries: An adult brass dragon carries the confidence of a practiced diplomat without losing the energy of a creature that genuinely enjoys talking to people. Years of negotiation have sharpened persuasion, insight, performance, and historical memory into practical tools rather than ornamental knowledge. When it chooses to dominate a conversation, even a battlefield can begin to feel like a negotiation chamber in which violence must first push through the weight of its voice.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Copper Dragon
entries: An adult copper dragon treats terrain with the same playful disrespect that it treats certainty, reshaping earth and stone as if architecture were merely another medium for improvisation. Its humor is backed by real investigative intelligence. It notices details, reads reactions, and understands how to make a distraction useful rather than merely funny. The battlefield around it can become stairs, trenches, slopes, barriers, and false assumptions in rapid succession.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Bronze Dragon
entries: An adult bronze dragon has the bearing of a guardian who expects danger and has already considered where it is most likely to come from. Athletics, insight, perception, and investigation combine into a battlefield awareness that makes it difficult to isolate or surprise those it has chosen to protect. Spells and supernatural attacks are not exempt from that vigilance. A failed defense can be granted another chance, and success may bring lightning back toward the source.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Silver Dragon
entries: An adult silver dragon carries an atmosphere of safety that is difficult to separate from its physical presence, as though standing near it places one behind an unseen shield. Its growing mastery of Arcana, Insight, Persuasion, and Medicine gives it the temperament of both guardian and magical specialist. Force barriers, counter-magic, restoration, and intervention now sit alongside cold and paralysis. It doesn't merely survive hostile magic; it creates space in which others can survive it too.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Gold Dragon
entries: An adult gold dragon possesses an unmistakable sovereign presence even when it makes no attempt to command anyone. Its knowledge of people, religion, magic, and diplomacy allows it to judge situations with far greater depth than the righteous certainty of its youth. Those it chooses to protect become harder to frighten, corrupt, or kill, while enemies placed under its judgment discover that simply remaining nearby can become painful.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Brass Dragon
entries: An ancient brass dragon has a presence that can make enormous distance feel conversational, its voice remaining clear and deliberate even when its body is nowhere nearby. It has spoken with enough cultures, travelers, rulers, scholars, and enemies to understand how differently the same words can be heard. Communication itself becomes supernatural territory. Distance, language, and ordinary acoustic limits matter less and less when the dragon decides something needs to be said.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
entries: An ancient copper dragon seems almost impossible to contain in places made from earth or stone, disappearing through surfaces and emerging where geometry says it should not. Centuries of tricks have given it a sophisticated understanding of expectation, attention, construction, movement, and the assumptions creatures make about space. Its magic rarely needs to overpower reality directly. It is usually enough to persuade reality to behave in a more inconvenient way.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon
entries: An ancient bronze dragon is a storm-centered sentinel, enormous enough to dominate a battlefield while still tracking individual threats within it. Its centuries of experience have taught it that protection is not passive. It studies movement, motive, terrain, survival, and the exact instant an attacker commits to harm. Those who injure its chosen allies become marked by the storm itself, turning aggression into a beacon for immediate punishment.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
entries: An ancient silver dragon looks almost sculpted from moonlit metal, its immense form surrounded by subtle distortions where hostile magic and Force effects fail to settle correctly. It has accumulated enough magical and social experience to recognize threats that are invisible to ordinary senses—coercion, displacement, imprisonment, hostile spell structure, and the signs of imminent collapse. Its Argent Aegis has become a refusal written into reality: banishment, forced movement, magical restraint, and Force itself struggle to claim authority over it.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Gold Dragon
entries: An ancient gold dragon resembles a living icon of fire and sunlight, enormous enough that its radiance can make a battlefield feel like a ceremonial hall. Its long memory includes civilizations, faiths, wars, laws, promises, and failures of leadership, giving its authority the weight of experience rather than appearance alone. Its judgment can strip away protections from fire and radiance, expose hidden enemies, and make cruelty itself a source of punishment.

monsterFluff.name: Brass Wyrm
entries: A brass wyrm is a titanic speaker whose physical scale is matched by the reach of its personality, capable of making enormous gatherings feel as though they are being addressed individually. Its social experience spans ages of diplomacy, storytelling, debate, insult, negotiation, mediation, and deliberate provocation. When it commands attention, violence can momentarily become secondary to speech itself. The world doesn't become peaceful—but it may be forced to listen first.

monsterFluff.name: Copper Wyrm
entries: A copper wyrm is immense, brilliant, and profoundly disrespectful toward the idea that an effect should finish exactly where its creator intended. Its long experience with illusion, movement, terrain, investigation, and deception gives it a near-instinctive sense for how an event can be redirected without being stopped. Teleportation, forced movement, magical travel, and areas of effect all become opportunities for one final joke: the magic works perfectly, just not where anyone expected.

monsterFluff.name: Bronze Wyrm
entries: A bronze wyrm is a living defensive line spanning hundreds of feet, its attention moving across a battlefield as quickly as lightning across a cloudbank. Its instincts have matured into absolute battlefield responsibility: it notices danger, understands intent, crosses distance with shocking speed, and intervenes before death can settle. Under its protection, a fatal blow may become merely another event the wyrm refuses to permit.

monsterFluff.name: Silver Wyrm
entries: A silver wyrm is a vast, luminous fortress in living form, wrapped in layers of cold radiance and invisible Force that bend hostile magic around its body. Its mind combines arcane mastery with perception, insight, diplomacy, and the accumulated responsibility of a protector that has watched generations live and die beneath the same sky.

Within its protection, magic becomes less absolute and death less immediate. Force barriers, anti-magic instincts, sanctuary, restoration, and sheer draconic will combine into an environment where destruction must work much harder to become final.

monsterFluff.name: Gold Wyrm
entries: A gold wyrm is a colossal presence of flame, sunlight, and authority, bright enough that its arrival can feel less like the entrance of a creature and more like dawn breaking across the battlefield. Its intellect carries ages of Arcana, faith, history, diplomacy, and moral judgment, tempered by the knowledge that even immense power doesn't make every decision simple.

When the Crown of the First Dawn manifests, allies endure what should destroy them while enemies find resistance, darkness, and fear losing their usual certainty. Its fire is no longer merely fire; it is whatever form of judgment the wyrm chooses to make visible.

monsterFluff.name: Brass Greatwyrm
entries: A brass greatwyrm has spoken with rulers, beggars, generals, murderers, saints, and civilizations that no longer exist. Its voice carries the accumulated weight of ages spent debating, negotiating, provoking, comforting, warning, and listening. When it decides that violence must wait, a battlefield can become a parliament beneath its shadow.

monsterFluff.name: Copper Greatwyrm
entries: A copper greatwyrm treats certainty as an invitation to improvise. Distance, direction, terrain, magical positioning, and even the intended destination of an effect become pieces of a joke only the dragon fully understands. At its final age, reality no longer merely tolerates its tricks; it seems to participate in them.

monsterFluff.name: Bronze Greatwyrm
entries: A bronze greatwyrm is a living defensive front, its awareness stretching across a battlefield like a storm system. Every attack against those beneath its protection becomes an event to intercept, answer, and punish. Victory against its allies is never certain while the greatwyrm still has strength enough to stand.

monsterFluff.name: Silver Greatwyrm
entries: A silver greatwyrm is a sanctuary given wings, wrapped in cold radiance and invisible Force that turns hostile magic aside. Its protection is no longer limited to resisting destruction; it creates a space in which destruction itself struggles to become final. Within the shelter of its presence, magic breaks, wounds close, and death waits for permission that may never come.

monsterFluff.name: Gold Greatwyrm
entries: A gold greatwyrm doesn't resemble sunrise so much as sunrise resembles it. Its flame, radiance, authority, mercy, and judgment have become different expressions of the same ancient power. When the First Dawn rises around it, allies endure beneath impossible light while cruelty finds nowhere left to hide.

monsterFluff.name: Amethyst Dragon Wyrmling
entries: An amethyst dragon wyrmling has dense violet crystalline scales and a compact, powerful frame that often seems strangely light or heavy from one moment to the next. It is curious about motion, distance, weight, and the hidden rules connecting objects, treating gravity almost like a puzzle it can prod with its mind. Force and psionic magic already answer that curiosity, allowing the wyrmling to alter local mass and collapse movement into brief moments of impossible stillness.

monsterFluff.name: Crystal Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A crystal dragon wyrmling is bright, translucent, and quick to reflect surrounding light through its scales in shifting prismatic patterns. It is sociable and emotionally expressive for a young dragon, often treating curiosity, encouragement, and protection as natural extensions of the same instinct. Its radiant psionics reinforce life rather than merely producing light, leaving protective vitality behind whenever its magic heals or burns through an enemy.

monsterFluff.name: Emerald Dragon Wyrmling
entries: An emerald dragon wyrmling is slender and jewel-toned, with reflective green scales that disappear surprisingly well among shadow, stone, and carefully placed illusions. It prefers to observe before committing itself, already learning how much can be discovered by controlling what others think they have seen or heard. Its psychic and illusion magic make secrecy an active weapon, hiding not only its body but even the apparent direction from which its thoughts arrive.

monsterFluff.name: Sapphire Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A sapphire dragon wyrmling is broad-clawed and deep blue, its crystalline body carrying faint vibrations that can be felt through nearby stone before they are heard. It is alert to movement and spatial relationships, instinctively noticing routes, chokepoints, hollow spaces, and the rhythm of creatures crossing the same ground. Thunder and psionic resonance turn those observations into a living tactical map, allowing even a young sapphire dragon to fight with unusual positional awareness.

monsterFluff.name: Topaz Dragon Wyrmling
entries: A topaz dragon wyrmling bears warm yellow-orange crystalline scales whose beauty contrasts sharply with the dry, draining quality of its supernatural presence. It is fascinated by erosion, evaporation, weakness, and the ordinary endings built into living and nonliving things, though its understanding is still that of an intelligent child. Its necrotic psionics accelerate small fragments of entropy, drying liquids, suppressing recovery, and leaving creatures briefly weakened by the touch of inevitable decline.

monsterFluff.name: Young Amethyst Dragon
entries: A young amethyst dragon is a dense, violet-crystal predator whose enormous wings move with an eerie lightness that seems inconsistent with its mass. Its curiosity about gravity has matured into deliberate experimentation, and it now approaches motion, distance, and force with the confidence of a natural philosopher who can physically test every theory. Around it, weight itself becomes tactical. Creatures can be pinned, liberated, halted, or dragged out of the sky while the dragon moves through space with psionic ease.

monsterFluff.name: Young Crystal Dragon
entries: A young crystal dragon gleams like living cut glass, scattering sunlight and magical radiance across its scales whenever it moves. Its natural optimism has become protective awareness rather than simple enthusiasm, and it has learned to recognize the exact moment another creature needs help most. Its radiant psionics increasingly flow outward instead of remaining self-contained, turning attacks, healing, and successful resistance into fresh protection for nearby allies.

monsterFluff.name: Young Emerald Dragon
entries: A young emerald dragon is elegant, quiet, and difficult to locate even when its voice seems close enough to touch. It has learned that concealment is most effective when an observer is given a convincing alternative to believe in, rather than merely denied information. Its illusions can now carry thought, attention, and apparent presence away from its true body, leaving enemies to fight the version of reality it deliberately supplied.

monsterFluff.name: Young Sapphire Dragon
entries: A young sapphire dragon carries a constant low resonance through its crystalline body, as though every nearby surface were part of an enormous instrument only it can hear clearly. Its instinctive spatial awareness has matured into tactical thinking, allowing it to read movement, initiative, chokepoints, and danger across an entire engagement. Thunder, vibration, and psionics now serve the same purpose: allies are warned and repositioned while enemies lose the ability to respond at the exact moment the dragon chooses to strike.

monsterFluff.name: Young Topaz Dragon
entries: A young topaz dragon has a dry, austere beauty, its orange-gold crystalline scales seeming to pull warmth and moisture from the air around their edges. Its fascination with endings has become more analytical, extending from dead matter and evaporation to the fragile processes by which living creatures recover from harm. Its psionic entropy can now occupy an area rather than a single target, suppressing healing, draining momentum, and making decay feel like a local law of nature.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Crystal Dragon
entries: An adult crystal dragon resembles an immense sculpture of living gemstone, its body scattering radiant light across the surrounding terrain with every movement. Its optimism has matured into deliberate guardianship. It understands injury, morale, fear, and recovery well enough to reinforce life at precisely the moment another creature begins to falter.

Its psionic radiance no longer merely protects individuals. Around the dragon, recovery becomes an environmental condition, as healing, temporary vitality, and renewed courage continuously pass between those it chooses to shelter.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Topaz Dragon
entries: An adult topaz dragon carries an atmosphere of dryness and quiet deterioration, its golden-orange crystalline scales beautiful in the same way a sunset can be beautiful at the end of a dying day. Centuries of observing erosion, death, hunger, weathering, and failed recovery have turned its fascination with endings into a disciplined understanding of entropy.

Its necrotic psionics can now attack a creature's capacity to recover rather than merely its current vitality, making wounds feel less temporary and turning an area around the dragon into a place where endings arrive faster.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Emerald Dragon
entries: An adult emerald dragon can occupy a room psychologically without anyone being certain which visible dragon is actually present. Its long practice with deception and observation has taught it that certainty itself is a resource—one that can be divided, redirected, and denied. Illusory bodies now carry its telepathic and magical presence across the battlefield, while the true dragon can exchange positions with a false self at the moment an enemy finally believes it has found the correct target.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Sapphire Dragon
entries: An adult sapphire dragon feels less like a combatant entering a battlefield and more like a commander connecting every surface, movement, and vibration into a single tactical system. Its knowledge of history and investigation gives context to what its senses reveal: formations, habits, likely retreats, structural weaknesses, and the moment an opponent commits too deeply to movement.
Within its resonant field, allies shift with unnatural coordination while enemies discover that even taking a few determined steps can trigger the exact counter-frequency needed to stop them.

monsterFluff.name: Adult Amethyst Dragon
entries: An adult amethyst dragon is a massive violet presence around which motion seems subtly unreliable, as though gravity and momentum are waiting for permission before deciding what direction to obey. Its immense intelligence has turned instinctive force manipulation into rigorous mastery of vectors, trajectories, displacement, and spatial relationships. A fall can become a sideways launch, a charge can lose its final thirty feet, and a thrown body can acquire a new direction in midair. Near an adult amethyst dragon, movement itself has become negotiable.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Crystal Dragon
entries: An ancient crystal dragon shines like a vast living prism, its crystalline body gathering and redistributing light until the space around it seems brighter simply because it is present. Its long experience with healing, morale, suffering, and recovery has transformed generosity into disciplined mastery rather than naïve optimism.

Within its radiant presence, vitality refuses to remain isolated. Excess healing becomes protection, restored strength passes from one creature to another, and harmful conditions are burned away by the same light that closes wounds.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Topaz Dragon
entries: An ancient topaz dragon feels like a dry season given consciousness, its immense golden-orange body surrounded by air that seems reluctant to carry moisture or renewal. It has watched enough cycles of life and death to understand entropy not as destruction but as a rule that can be locally intensified. Around it, regeneration fails, healing disappears before it can take hold, and even attempts to reverse deterioration can be rejected by the dragon's psionic insistence that some endings should remain endings.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Emerald Dragon
entries: An ancient emerald dragon can appear to occupy many places at once, each visible body carrying enough voice, thought, and magical presence to seem completely authentic. Centuries of observation have taught it that targeting depends upon certainty, and certainty is merely another perception that can be manipulated.

Its true position becomes a distributed question rather than a simple location. Spells may strike convincing false selves, telepathy reveals no direction, and hostile minds can spend precious magic proving that the dragon they chose was never there.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Sapphire Dragon
entries: An ancient sapphire dragon experiences battle as an enormous field of vibration, intent, history, and timing rather than a collection of isolated combatants. Its strategic memory spans wars, sieges, collapses, retreats, and victories, giving meaning to every movement its resonance detects. Within its influence, allies can exchange the very order in which they act, receive commands between turns, and move as though a single tactical intelligence were coordinating the entire battlefield.

monsterFluff.name: Ancient Amethyst Dragon
entries: An ancient amethyst dragon is surrounded by subtle distortions of distance and weight, its violet crystalline mass seeming to bend the geometry of nearby motion before it deliberately uses any power. Its understanding of force has expanded beyond trajectories into the deeper relationship between position, gravity, escape, and the boundaries creatures assume space must obey.

When it establishes an Event Horizon, movement becomes a contest against the dragon's intellect. Flight collapses, teleportation can fail at the boundary, and everything nearby begins to discover how difficult it is to move away from a center the amethyst has chosen.

monsterFluff.name: Crystal Wyrm
entries: A crystal wyrm is a vast living prism whose presence can turn an entire battlefield into a place of relentless recovery, refracting radiance through scales large enough to resemble architecture. Its understanding of life is no longer limited to healing wounds. It recognizes vitality as something transferable, overflowable, and resistant to the ordinary mechanisms by which bodies deteriorate.

Within its Life Nexus, survival becomes contagious. Healing spreads across allies, excess recovery becomes layered protection, and effects meant to reduce, age, or suppress living bodies find themselves opposed by the wyrm's insistence that life can continue beyond its normal limit.

monsterFluff.name: Topaz Wyrm
entries: A topaz wyrm resembles entropy made monumental, its enormous crystalline body surrounded by air, soil, and living matter that seem one step closer to exhaustion whenever it draws near. It has watched civilizations, species, structures, and resurrected heroes all struggle against endings, and it no longer treats restoration as fundamentally different from any other temporary resistance to decay.

Within its Entropic Dominion, recovery becomes a privilege the wyrm can revoke. Healing disappears, maximum vitality erodes, resurrection carries lingering damage, and creatures already near death discover that even emergency restoration can simply be refused.

monsterFluff.name: Emerald Wyrm
entries: An emerald wyrm can fill hundreds of feet with convincing selves, each duplicate speaking, thinking, and serving as a point from which its magic appears to originate. Its identity has become distributed across perception so thoroughly that asking where the true dragon is can become the wrong question.

Within its psychic field, certainty collapses into consensus—and consensus is optional. A spell may target the wrong dragon, divination may discover thought without location, and the wyrm can simply decide that another visible self is where it has always been.

monsterFluff.name: Sapphire Wyrm
entries: A sapphire wyrm experiences a battlefield as a single resonant network extending hundreds of feet through stone, air, movement, thought, and intention. Its strategic intelligence has outgrown ordinary command. Initiative order, repositioning, reaction timing, and allied communication are all variables it can reorganize while combat is already unfolding.

Creatures fighting beside it begin to resemble one distributed army with a single tactical mind, while enemies discover that every movement, attack, spell, or teleport may be answered before the action has fully resolved.

monsterFluff.name: Amethyst Wyrm
entries: An amethyst wyrm is a colossal distortion in violet crystal, so saturated with control over force and gravity that nearby motion can appear visibly curved around its body. Its intellect no longer treats space as a passive container. Distance, trajectory, escape, flight, teleportation, and even the path of a projectile are relationships that can be rewritten inside a field of sufficient psionic authority.

When Sovereign Singularity forms, the battlefield acquires a new center of reality. Creatures fall toward it, teleportation locks at its boundaries, projectiles curve through impossible angles, and the wyrm decides what movement is still permitted to mean.

monsterFluff.name: Crystal Greatwyrm
entries: A Crystal Greatwyrm is radiant persistence made flesh, a mind so ancient that life around it seems to resist the very idea of ending. Its psionic light does more than heal wounds; it reinforces possibility, carries vitality between allies, and turns excess restoration into reserves of living brilliance. Within its presence, survival becomes contagious.

monsterFluff.name: Topaz Greatwyrm
entries: A Topaz Greatwyrm embodies ending without hatred or haste. To it, decay is neither cruelty nor tragedy but a law that eventually reaches flesh, magic, memory, and empire alike. When its Entropic Dominion unfolds, recovery itself begins to feel temporary.

monsterFluff.name: Emerald Greatwyrm
entries: An Emerald Greatwyrm has carried distributed identity beyond illusion and into a form of psionic existence. Its images speak, observe, misdirect, and serve as legitimate points from which its will can enter the world. Opponents may understand every principle behind the deception and still be unable to prove which dragon was ever the original.

monsterFluff.name: Sapphire Greatwyrm
entries: A Sapphire Greatwyrm experiences battle as a solved structure whose pieces have not yet realized where they belong. Vibration, initiative, movement, spellcasting, and tactical intent form a single predictive network in its mind. Its allies rarely seem faster than their enemies; they simply seem to have acted at exactly the correct moment.

monsterFluff.name: Amethyst Greatwyrm
entries: An Amethyst Greatwyrm no longer treats gravity as an environmental force. Mass, direction, momentum, distance, and position exist as relationships that its mind can renegotiate. When its final singularity forms, the battlefield itself begins falling according to the dragon's decision.

A pale afterimage follows each strike. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this magic weapon. Each hit against a creature creates a delayed copy of the attack. At the start of your next turn, each copy repeats against its original target if still within the weapon's normal reach or range.

items: Roll a new attack roll using the same attack bonus as the original attack.
The repeated attack requires no Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
On a hit, it deals the weapon's normal damage plus 1d8 Force damage.
It otherwise counts as an attack made with the weapon.
A repeated ranged attack doesn't expend ammunition.
A repeated attack can't create another delayed attack.

If the original target is no longer a valid target, you can redirect the repeated attack to another creature within 5 feet of the original target's last position, provided that creature is within the weapon's normal reach or range.

entries: There is no limit to the number of delayed attacks you can have at one time.

Impacts gather beneath this armor, waiting to be released. You gain a +2 bonus to AC while wearing it. Whenever you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Force damage, it records the damage actually taken after Resistance and other reductions.

Before the end of your next turn, the next time you hit a creature with an attack, you can release the stored force through that attack. The target takes additional Force damage equal to half the recorded damage, rounded up. If you take qualifying damage multiple times before releasing it, the amounts are added together. There is no limit to how much damage can be accumulated this way, but all stored damage disappears at the end of your next turn if you haven't released it.
If the attack used to release the stored force is a Critical Hit, the additional Force damage is instead equal to the full amount of damage recorded.
